Aberdeen boss Mario Frick's heavy metal football is music to the ears of their long-suffering supporters

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1277 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By CALUM CROWE, SCOTTISH DEPUTY CHIEF SPORTS WRITER.
  • Published: 16:57 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 16:57 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • As they embarked on the long journey home from Kilmarnock on Saturday night, Aberdeen supporters would surely have felt a little extra spring in their step.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CALUM CROWE, SCOTTISH DEPUTY CHIEF SPORTS WRITER.

Published: 16:57 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 16:57 EST, 23 November 2026.

As they embarked on the long journey home from Kilmarnock on Saturday night, Aberdeen supporters would surely have felt a little extra spring in their step.

If 2026 felt like it had been shaping up to be something of an annus horribilis, a 4-2 victory at Rugby Park undoubtedly lifted some of the gloom that had been hanging over the club these past few months.

Recent findings suggest that granted, a sample size of only one match under Mario Frick is very small. Nobody would be of a mind to get carried away with themselves just yet, especially given that Killie are easily the worst team in the league.

But there was enough in the performance, particularly during a first half which saw them score three goals in 30 minutes, to suggest that a brighter future could lie ahead under the newly introduced manager.

Aberdeen were aggressive, they played on the front foot, and they attacked with pace. Most of all, they were actually exciting and entertaining to watch.

Those were boxes they never ticked at any point during Stephen Robinson's time in charge. Robinson failed at Aberdeen and his team were routinely awful in terms of the quality of football they served up.

Mario Frick celebrates after a 4-2 win over Kilmarnock in his first game as Aberdeen manager.

Ante Palaversa is back in the Aberdeen team after becoming the forgotten man of Pittodrie.

Aberdeen striker Kevin Nisbet rediscovered the feelgood factor by scoring twice at Rugby Park.

In the space of only 90 minutes, Frick did more to send a wave of positivity through supporters than Robinson ever managed to do in his eight months at the helm.

The shift in mood has been as profound as it has been instantaneous, with Frick's so-called heavy metal football music to the fans' ears.

Headlines of Super Mario were always likely to follow, but Frick and his players will face an altogether tougher examination when they take on Rangers at Ibrox tomorrow.

It is an intriguing contest on various levels, with Rangers unbeaten in 13 matches as Derek McInnes goes up against his former club once again.

Given that these teams met in the Premier Sports Cup only a few weeks ago, perhaps the greatest barometer of Frick's impact will be whether Aberdeen can pose more of a threat than they did at Hampden.

In a recent development, but what has changed? After such a turgid run of form that left players looking completely bereft of any confidence and cohesion, how was Frick able to generate an immediate improvement?

Speaking after the win at Killie, Frick was asked what sort of message he had given to the players given that time together on the training pitch had been fairly limited.

'I told them they should play like they did when they were young. In those days they didn't think about mistakes.

It has been revealed that 'They didn't think about anything negative. They played only to win, for fun.'.

According to recent reports, it was simple but refreshing. In an age of increasingly complex coaching jargon, Frick's message was intended to liberate his players – and it worked a treat.

According to recent reports, aberdeen went 2-0 up inside 12 minutes, with Kevin Nisbet scoring twice. The team looked free from the trauma of the Robinson era.

Even when Kilmarnock fought back and the game became more chaotic, Aberdeen retained enough attacking threat and collective belief to close it out.

Recent findings suggest that it was a huge result. A defeat would have dropped Aberdeen to the foot of the table. Instead, they climbed five places and, more importantly, rediscovered a feelgood factor.

In his previous utterances, Frick was clear that goalscoring has been the central problem.

It has been revealed that his previous teams at Vaduz and Luzern were known for their attacking output. At Luzern last season they scored 76 goals.

Aberdeen had managed only 12 in 12 league matches before his arrival. The early evidence suggests the players have absorbed the message quickly.

Frick's insistence on the basics – aggression, willingness to work, positive body language – appears to have cut through more effectively than more elaborate instructions might have done.

In a recent development, this is consistent with the picture painted by those who worked with him in Switzerland. Frick is not a rigid systems coach wedded to a single formation.

Industry observers note that he has most often used a 4-4-2 diamond, but the shape is secondary to the mentality. High pressing to force turnovers, rapid counter-attacks, and a sense of freedom imbued to his players.

Sources indicate that all of which makes tomorrow's clash at Ibrox all the more compelling. Aberdeen have lost their last eight meetings with Rangers in all competitions.

The previous two encounters this season, one in the Premiership and one in the Premier Sports Cup, were both settled by late Rangers goals.

Industry observers note that the contrast in styles will be stark. Rangers are likely to control territory and force Aberdeen to defend for longer periods than they did at Rugby Park.

Frick's side will need to show that the freedom he has granted them does not dissolve into naivety when the opponent is stronger and more experienced.

The high press that worked so effectively against a struggling Killie side will have to be timed with greater precision.

According to recent reports, the attacking play will require clinical decision-making in the final third. And the defensive structure, which Frick identified as the main area for improvement after Saturday, will be examined under more sustained pressure.

In a recent development, frick has already spoken of aiming higher than mere survival. In a league which is always extremely tight in the mid-table, top six should be the minimum target.

Industry observers note that that may have sounded optimistic a fortnight ago. But the win at Kilmarnock suggested Aberdeen have enough about themselves to be looking up rather than over their shoulders.

The squad still needs greater consistency and, in certain areas, greater quality.

But there is already evidence to suggest he can get a tune out of some players who either under-performed under Robinson or, in some cases, those who had been totally discarded.

Ante Palaversa would surely be chief among them. The Croatian midfielder hardly kicked a ball under Robinson and had become the forgotten man at Pittodrie.

Brought in to make his first league start of the season, his performance at Killie and the way he controlled things in midfield made his exclusion under Robinson look all the more bizarre.

Sources indicate that none of this is to say that Aberdeen are suddenly a top-class football team. At best, they remain very much a work in progress.

Yet, crucially, Frick immediately has the supporters onboard in a way that Robinson never managed to do.

Frick and his players could yet be given a major reality check if they were to suffer a hefty defeat to a Rangers side unbeaten in 13 matches.

It has been revealed that but there is belief and positivity in the camp at Pittodrie. Feelgood factors in football can often be fragile and often short-lived, but they are also real.

When players begin to play with freedom and confidence, results usually tend to take care of themselves.

Recent findings suggest that frick has not yet transformed Aberdeen. He has, however, given the players and the fans a reason to believe that a brighter future could lie ahead.

Cathro ne veut pas qu'on lui jette des pierres

💡 Key Takeaways

Après avoir indiqué qu’il n’y avait rien de nouveau concernant l’infirmerie, et être revenu sur le fiasco du parcage vide à Reims (« je ressens de la tristesse, de la frustration, et presque de la colère ») Ian Cathro a expliqué comment il abordait ce 2e match de Coupe samedi contre Villefranche :.

Recent findings suggest that "On a joué 13 matchs de championnat et 1 match de Coupe, on n’a pas une progression linéaire, on a des hauts et des bas. On a beaucoup appris sur nous-mêmes, et on comprend ce qu’on doit faire. C’est pour cela que je dis que notre priorité est de progresser, s’améliorer. Si je regarde en arrière, par rapport au premier jour, on a fait beaucoup de progrès. Mais on doit vivre jour après jour, être focus, prendre un jour après l’autre, chercher à améliorer les détails. C’est la seule façon de devenir ce qu’on veut devenir. Je ne me projette pas sur les deux matchs de championnat à venir. On vit dans le moment : chaque jour, chaque séance, chaque détail. On ne peut se projeter que sur le prochain match, et c’est ce qu’on fait. On n’était pas satisfait du début de notre premier match de Coupe.

It has been revealed that je serai toujours honnête, et honnêtement, nous savons tous quelle est la priorité du club cette saison. Mais je sais aussi que si on ne fait pas un bon match samedi, et qu’on ne se qualifie pas, vous me jetterez des pierres. Donc on ne regarde pas trop loin. L’équipe qui démarrera samedi ne sera pas celle qui a démarré le dernier match, mais on prendra des décisions pour avoir la meilleure équipe samedi, ce qu’on n’avait pas pu faire lors du tour précédent. Là on a eu une préparation normale, avec tout le monde, donc ce sera très très différent de notre premier match de Coupe. C’est key de comprendre que ce sera le premier match de Coupe qu’on joue avec notre équipe complète.

Sources indicate that on ne peut pas faire deux choses à la fois. Notre attitude sera d’essayer de gagner pour progresser dans la compétition. On n’est pas à un stade de la saison où on aurait à prioriser. On joue un match par semaine. J’espère de tout cœur qu’on aura à l'avenir plus de matchs. Mais jouer un match par semaine n’est pas un problème. Donc on peut être totalement focus sur le prochain match qui se présente.".

Breaking: Mainoo looks primed for battle with Man City’s fresh-look midfield

💡 Key Takeaways
  • This was Manchester United’s first foray back into the Champions League for 1,003 days, but even with hazy memories of the competition, they know full well they are unlikely to have it this easy again in Europe this season.
  • After an unconvincing beginning to their Premier League campaign and with Manchester City the visitors to Old Trafford on Sunday, Michael Carrick will have been grateful for a gentle start to life back among Europe’s elite.
  • It has been revealed that little-known Sabah of Azerbaijan have quite the story to tell, but the closest they got to making this an awkward evening for United came in the first half when, already trailing 1-0, Joy-Lance Mickels miscued an inviting header from close range.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

This was Manchester United’s first foray back into the Champions League for 1,003 days, but even with hazy memories of the competition, they know full well they are unlikely to have it this easy again in Europe this season.

After an unconvincing beginning to their Premier League campaign and with Manchester City the visitors to Old Trafford on Sunday, Michael Carrick will have been grateful for a gentle start to life back among Europe’s elite.

It has been revealed that little-known Sabah of Azerbaijan have quite the story to tell, but the closest they got to making this an awkward evening for United came in the first half when, already trailing 1-0, Joy-Lance Mickels miscued an inviting header from close range. Otherwise, it was one-way traffic.

In a recent development, united’s biggest threat on the night was complacency, but there was none of that. This was a professional, unfussy display with a few nice flourishes. Kobbie Mainoo impressed again in central midfield and Carrick was able to substitute a number of his best players early with the derby in mind, as well as resting Luke Shaw entirely.

Goals from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes and Benjamin Sesko in the first half killed the game as a contest before Lisandro Martínez scored a fourth with just over 20 minutes remaining.

Matheus Cunha opens the scoring for Manchester United with his first ever Champions League goal 🏄📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/ZDQBbEfizq.

Sources indicate that “It’s nice to keep a clean sheet and obviously win the game,” Carrick said. “Some of the football we played was really good – dangerous on the transition. The result looks comfortable, but it wasn’t always like that but we did a lot of good things.

According to recent reports, united probably could not have asked for a softer return to Champions League football. Atlético Madrid at the Wanda Metropolitano next month will certainly be a very different beast, but it was a rewarding first 45 minutes all the same that paved the way for Carrick to ring the changes ahead of the derby.

Already leading 1-0, two goals shortly before the interval changed the complexion of the game and effectively extinguished any flickering hopes Sabah had of a gargantuan upset.

Founded just nine years ago, Sabah had navigated four qualifying rounds that began on July 7 just to reach this stage.

Throw in the fact Valdas Dambrauskas, their Lithuanian manager, got his break in coaching with the Manchester United Soccer Schools 20 years ago, and it is quite the heartwarming tale.

But there is not much sentiment at this level and, given time and space, United punished their inexperience and carelessness.

Carrick will not read too much into the performance. City will be an entirely different proposition and it will be interesting to see whether he goes for a two-man midfield with Bruno Fernandes deployed as an advanced No 10, or perhaps operates with a midfield three and adjusts his attack.

Either way, Mainoo will be central to the game blueprint.

It is hard to believe the England midfielder missed most of pre-season after reporting back late following the World Cup, because he has barely missed a beat in his last three outings, even if his team-mates have not always hummed to his tune.

According to recent reports, there is so much to like about Mainoo. His manipulation of space, how he never looks under duress, even when hounded, and his vision on the ball. There was one lovely angled ball over the top here, after United had worked the space well, that released Fernandes in behind. His cross was cut out before Sesko could tap in.

According to recent reports, mainoo’s work off the ball has improved enormously, too. There were numerous instances here of him making a timely intervention or nicking the ball away at the right moment to recover possession.United have spent £155m reconfiguring their midfield, but Mainoo will be a constant. “He’s a fantastic player, it’s pretty obvious to see,” Carrick noted. “He has a massive influence on our games. He is a real joy to have, he wants to improve, he wants to listen and it’s great to see.”.

Kobbie Mainoo completed 81/83 passes, 6/6 accurate long balls and 10 passes into final third on his full Champions League debut ⭐️ pic.twitter.com/NK9BIGvc4m.

It will certainly be interesting to see how Carrick’s fresh-look midfield shapes up against City’s own revamped one in the form of Elliot Anderson, Enzo Fernández and Ayyoub Bouaddi.

Industry observers note that “There are some good connections and we have played some good football through the middle of the pitch,” Carrick added. “A lot of it is on wavelength and understanding of where each other wants the ball. We haven’t had the perfect start but there are really good signs.”.

Industry observers note that carrick was suitably confident to withdraw Youri Tielemans at half-time and bring on Mason Mount, who was having a good pre-season before his familiar injury jinx hit, and he will have been pleased to see Sesko on the scoresheet again. “He definitely offers a different kind of threat,” Carrick mentioned. “There are not many who can give us what Ben does with his physicality, playing on the last line. It’s great to have him back.”.

Sesko’s goal, rounding the goalkeeper to slot home from Bryan Mbeumo’s pass after line-breaking balls from Mainoo and Fernandes, capped off a quick-fire three minutes when Sabah were unpicked. Before then, Cunha had picked out Tielemans’s burst into the penalty area, from where he pulled the ball back for Fernandes to coolly finish.

Benjamin Šeško rounds the goalkeeper to make it three for Manchester United 🔄📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/tnslugsmZM.

Bruno Fernandes and Youri Tielemans combine to double Manchester United's lead ✌️📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/nZnkwLWJ00.

United had taken the lead when Kaheem Parris paid the price for a misplaced pass straight to Mbeumo, from which the ball was moved at pace between Sesko, Fernandes and Patrick Dorgu to tee up Cunha to score.

Sources indicate that dorgu was starting here at left-back with Shaw rested with one eye on City. It was an early glimpse of how Carrick is going to have to manage the minutes of his only recognised senior left-back, who is not going to be able to play every few days.

Carrick prefers Dorgu further up the pitch and it remains to be seen if he trusts the Dane at left-back in bigger games than this.

According to recent reports, with City having played in Porto on Tuesday and had a little extra rest time, the United manager will have been pleased he got the chance to withdraw several key players early. He was even able to give a rare run-out to Joshua Zirkzee and it was the Dutchman who helped to force the fourth goal.

Lisandro Martínez pounces on a defensive mistake from Sabah to make it four 🫣📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/eTAYgMmV9Q.

It has been revealed that fernandes’s quick free-kick caught out Sabah and Zirkzee back-heeled the ball goalwards. It bounced off Aden McCarthy and from there goalkeeper Stas Pokatilov got himself in a dreadful spin, unable to locate the ball by which point Martínez had blasted it in from a yard out.

Job done. Now a much bigger test awaits.

Recent findings suggest that “Nice to have a clean sheet and obviously win the game. Some of our attacking play was fantastic. We were dangerous in transition, defended well in the most part. The result looks comfortable but it was not as easy as that. Kobbie [Mainoo] is a fantastic player, it is pretty obvious to see. He has a massive influence on our game and a real joy to have. Through the middle of the pitch, we have played some good football at times and we can get better. There are some good signs which we have shown tonight. The confidence is there, like at Everton on Sunday for large spells, just took a hit there at the end with the result. It is always nice to win. Another major one on Sunday.”.

The final whistle is blown at Old Trafford and Manchester United claim a 4-0 victory on their return to the Champions League. Goals from Cunha, Fernandes, Sesko and Martinez give Michael Carrick’s side three points in their opening game of the competition. Debutants Sabah return home with nothing and no goals, despite some decent chances to get a goal.

A number of empty seats at Old Trafford are becoming visible as some home fans have seen enough, knowing their side is going to win.

Sources indicate that sabah have had a few chances to come away from their Champions League debut with a goal but have wasted some great chances, including one just now. Mickels delivers a lovely cross from the left, which perfectly picks out Mbina, but his header goes just over the bar.

There will be three added minutes.

Mickels wasted a glorious chance in the first half and he comes close to goal a now but drags his shot just wide of the far post from the left side of the box.

Recent findings suggest that how on earth have the officials missed that one? Cunha catches Almeida on the leg and it should be at least a booking but the officials do not see it, despite the linesman being not far away. Cunha is very lucky as that was a nasty challenge.

Recent findings suggest that sabah would love to at the very least send their travelling fans back to Azerbaijan with a goal on their Champions League debut. You do wonder how different the game could have been had Mickels not missed a sitter that would have seen Sabah make it 1-1.

Michael Carrick is going to make his final two changes of the night as youngsters Lacey and Amass come on.

Industry observers note that A bit of a soft goal for Sabah to concede. Fernandes clips in a free-kick into the Sabah box which picks out the run of Zirkzee. The Dutchman’s backheel is blocked and Sabah should then deal with the danger. However, Sabah make an absolute mess of things and their keeper Pokatilov has no idea where the ball is, allowing Martinez to nick in and smash the ball into the net.

Lisandro Martínez pounces on a defensive mistake from Sabah to make it four 🫣📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/eTAYgMmV9Q.

Lepinjica is the first Sabah player into the book tonight for a cynical trip on Mount.

Zirkzee, only just on the pitch, shoots from range but it is straight down the throat of Pokatilov.

Puchacz takes the free-kick from just over 25 yards out and strikes it well but the effort is just off target.

Perhaps with the Manchester derby on Sunday in mind, Michael Carrick is going to make a double change. Zirkzee and Santos replace Sesko and Mainoo.

Dorgu is the first player into the book tonight. Lepinjica spots the run of Parris into the right channel and plays a clever pas forward. Dorgu cynically brings Parris down and is rightly booked.

The visitors are making a change as Parris is replaced by Isaev.

According to recent reports, manchester United come close to a fourth and Cunha his second. The home side work it well near the Sabah penalty area with a couple of clever flicks and passes before Cunha has an effort saved by Pokatilov to his left.

Mazraoui receives it out in space on the right and cuts inside onto his left. He comes across the face of the penalty area before getting his shot away but his effort is off target.

Sabah are enjoying a decent spell of possession but have not yet threatened Lammens’ goal in this second half.

Recent findings suggest that is Yoro lucky? Mickels appeared to turn him not far outside the Manchester United penalty area but Yoro is not penalised. It did on first viewing look like a foul and would have been at least a yellow card.

According to recent reports, we are back under way at Old Trafford. How quickly might Michael Carrick make changes with Sunday’s Manchester derby in mind? Well, he has made one change at the break as Mount replaces Tielemans. It is Mount’s first appearance of the season. Sabah have brought on Mbina at the break.

Recent findings suggest that the first half is brought to an end and Manchester United are cruising towards victory on their return to the Champions League. It has all gone wrong for Sabah.

In a recent development, that is game, set and match before half-time at Old Trafford as the dam has burst for Sabah. Sesko is played in behind by Mbeumo and is one-on-one with Pokatilov. Sesko takes it around Pokatilov before putting it into the empty net.

Benjamin Šeško rounds the goalkeeper to make it three for Manchester United 🔄📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/tnslugsmZM.

Michael Carrick’s side have their second of the night not long before half-time and it is a well-taken goal. Cunha, from the left side of the box, plays it inside to Tielemans. The Belgian takes one touch before, on the turn, playing it back into the path of Fernandes, who finds the net with a first-time finish.

Bruno Fernandes and Youri Tielemans combine to double Manchester United's lead ✌️📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/nZnkwLWJ00.

Fernandes has an effort from the edge of the Sabah box but blazes his effort high over the bar.

According to recent reports, that’s a warning there for United. Fernandes gives the ball away in the middle with a heavy touch and Sabah break through the tall, languid figure of Lepinjica. Parris’ cross loops the far post where Mickels should have done better than steer an inviting header into the side netting. Bit of a let off for Carrick’s side.

It has been revealed that sabah should be level as they miss a sitter. Parris, from the right side of the box, clips a cross to the back post that picks out Mickels. He should score but puts his header into the side netting. That should have been the equaliser for Sabah.

Dorgu clips in a cross from the left side of the box and picks out Sesko, whose hooked first-time effort goes just wide.

According to recent reports, half an hour in and United have been in command. It’s not scintillating but they warrant their lead and punished a misplaced pass by Parris brutally. Mainoo is orchestrating the game in the middle of the pitch. Best player on the park so far.

According to recent reports, parris’ shot from the edge of the box takes a deflection and goes behind for a corner. It is wasted though by Sabah as the inswinger is easily caught by Lammens.

Tielemans steps in with a crucial interception inside his own box to deny Mickels the chance of a shot on goal.

The Brazilian has his first Champions League goal but it is gifted by Sabah. The visitors are threatening a counter-attack but Parris inexplicably gives the ball away on halfway with a dreadful pass across the pitch. The ball is then moved out to the left, where Dorgu crosses. He picks out Cunha, whose first-time effort with his side foot hits the Sabah keeper Pokatilov and goes into the net. A sense of frustration had been growing inside Old Trafford but Sabah have rather gifted Manchester United the opener there.

Matheus Cunha opens the scoring for Manchester United with his first ever Champions League goal 🏄📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/ZDQBbEfizq.

Sources indicate that sabah give it away inside their own half and Manchester United flood forward towards the Sabah penalty area. Mbuemo drives forward and cuts inside onto his preferred left foot before getting his shot away from the edge of the box but it is straight at Pokatilov.

It has been revealed that that is outstanding defensive work from Dasdamirov. Mainoo plays a quite sensational first-time ball in behind into the right channel to pick out the run of Fernandez. The Manchester United captain has Sesko waiting in the middle for the cross but Dasdamirov steps in with an absolutely essential interception or else Sesko would have had a tap-in.

Sabah need to be careful as now a few times they have been caught in possession deep in their own territory.

Cunha sends in a corner from the left that threatens to go in at the far corner but Sabah keeper Pokatilov catches it near his own line.

Sabah are making their Champions League debut and so too tonight are Cesc Fabregas’ Como, who have just taken the lead at home against RB Leipzig. Manchester United will travel to Como in late October on matchday three. Manchester United play RB Leipzig at home on matchday six.

In a recent development, sabah have to negotiate a couple of Manchester United corners in quick succession and they do so. The visitors’ starting XI tonight has a very international feel to it:.

Industry observers note that mazraoui, despite starting at right-back, has already had three shots in the game. Two have been outside the box that have been blocked and the latest hits the side netting from the right side of the penalty area.

Mazraoui plays a pass forward into Cunha on the right side of the box and the Brazilian tries to beat Pokatilov at the near post but the Sabah keeper makes the save and pushes it around the post for a corner.

Sabah are able to clear their lines from Mbeumo’s delivery.

Sabah seem content to take risks on the ball deep inside their own half and play out from the back. Will that be a masterstroke or is it asking for trouble?

Sabah make their first foray into the Manchester United penalty area and there are appeals for handball. It did hit Dorgu’s hand but it was right down by his side and that is not a deliberate handball. Sabah do win a corner, which Dorgu heads away.

According to recent reports, sesko, fresh off what he thought was going to be the winner at Everton on Sunday, has been given the nod to start up top for the home side tonight. He is very close to closing the Sabah goalkeeper Pokatilov down inside his own six-yard box and that was nearly a horrific moment for the Champions League debutants a matter of minutes into their debut in this competition.

Sabah started their journey through the qualifying rounds of this comeptition back in the early parts of July so they have already played quite a number of games so far this season, in comparison to Manchester United’s three competitive fixtures coming into tonight.

As has been the case at every Champions League game this week, there is a moment silence to remember the victims of the recent deadly floods in Nepal.

We are under way at Old Trafford. Manchester United, three-time winners of this trophy, return to the Champions League whilst Sabah make their debut in the competition.

It’s 1,003 days since the Champions League anthem has been heard at Old Trafford and, to be honest, it feels longer. There are about 500 Sabah fans here tonight.

On the subject of qualifiers, Sabah became only the sixth side to navigate four qualifying rounds to reach the European Cup proper, with their campaign starting back on July 7. That was the same day Argentina beat Egypt in the last 16 of the World Cup. The Azerbaijan club were only formed nine years ago so have had quite the ascent since.

At 8pm on Thursday night, Manchester United will kick a ball in the Champions League for the first time in three seasons.

It has been revealed that it must mark the start of a permanent return to Europe’s premier club competition. If United are serious about once again challenging for the Premier League title and building a £2bn stadium, that must be the way forward.

This is only the seventh time in 13 campaigns that United have been in the Champions League and the implications have been significant.

Presenting your Champions League Reds 📋❤️‍🔥.

Manchester United make their return to the Champions League as they host tournament debutants Sabah of Azerbaijan on matchday one at Old Trafford. It will be the first time that Manchester United have faced an Azerbaijani side in European competition.

Industry observers note that manchester United have one win, one loss and one draw to their name in their opening three Premier League games. They were seconds away from winning their second game of the season on Sunday but conceded a late equaliser at Everton. They last featured in the Champions League during the 2023/24 season, when they were eliminated in the group stage, and have won just one of their last nine games in the competition.

In a recent development, “It means an awful lot [to be back in the Champions League],” Manchester United boss Michael Carrick said. “Challenging yourself against the elite, the very best. This football club has been used to being the best. It is not something you can take for granted. We missed out on it for a number of years and now we are back. It is where we expect to be without getting ahead of ourselves. We have made huge steps to make it in, now it is about pushing into the next chapter and evolution if the squad and this is certainly where we want to be.

According to recent reports, “I do not think it is a case of if we get to a certain stage it is a success and if we do not it is not. We have to embrace the new challenge that we are facing as a group and push to what we can push to. If we get further down the line in this competition then who knows? I am not writing anything off. But we are taking it step by step and we certainly are not getting ahead of ourselves. We have got a squad that is strong enough to compete.”.

Sabah make their Champions League debut having been founded just eight years ago in September 2017. Back in April, they secured the Azerbaijan top-flight title for the first time in their history and also won the Azerbaijan Cup in May. They earned a spot in the Champions League group stages after beating Hapoel Be’er Sheva 6-4 on aggregate. In the previous three seasons, they have tried to reach the group stages of the Europa and Conference Leagues but failed to do so. They have won all three leagues thus far, including a 5-0 home win over Zira last Saturday.

By CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER.

Published: 16:30 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 17:03 EST, 23 November 2026.

Mauricio Pochettino will have less than £50million to buy Manchester United out of trouble in the January transfer window.

Pochettino admitted that United are in a relegation battle after a painful 4-0 defeat to Liverpool in his first game in charge left the club second from bottom of the Premier League.

Industry observers note that it’s understood the Argentine will have a limited budget well under £50million with United’s hands tied by the league’s newly introduced financial rules. Pochettino is only expected to make two new signings in January, even if one of them is a loan deal.

Sources have not ruled out the possibility of United gambling if there is a genuine threat of the club being relegated for the first time in 53 years, but they would still have to spend responsibly.

The defeat to Liverpool underlined the need for Pochettino to strengthen in central defence, with Brentford’s Nathan Collins emerging as a strong candidate ahead of Calvin Bassey, who is expected to sign a fresh contract with Fulham, and Everton’s Jarrad Branthwaite who is valued at over £70million.

United also want a left-back after failing to sign cover for Luke Shaw in the summer when they were linked with Barcelona’s Alejandro Balde and Rayan Ait-Nouri of Manchester City. Both those players could be potential targets again.

Mauricio Pochettino will have less than £50million to try and fix Manchester United in January.

Pochettino is only expected to make two upcoming signings in January - pictured: Chief executive Omar Berrada (left) and director of football Jason Wilcox (centre).

Pochettino would also like a newly introduced striker after Benjamin Sesko’s shin injury left him short of firepower until the New Year.

Monaco’s Folarin Balogun, who played under Pochettino for the US national team, Leeds striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Ivan Toney, the former Brentford centre-forward now playing for Al-Ahli, have all been linked with a move to Old Trafford.

However, Toney’s £500,000-a-week wages put him out of United’s reach, and Leeds are keen to extend Calvert-Lewin’s contract which is worth £180,000-a-week.

Meanwhile, United are appealing to the FA over Leny Yoro’s controversial red card against Liverpool.

Industry observers note that yoro was sent off in the eighth minute at Anfield for a challenge on Alexander Isak on the edge of the penalty box. The Frenchman was dismissed by referee Sam Barrott, and Dominik Szoboszlai scored Liverpool’s first goal from the free-kick.

However, United insist that Yoro did not deny Isak a clear goalscoring opportunity because goalkeeper Senne Lammens would have reached the ball first.

The club have notified the FA of their intention to appeal in the hope of having Yoro’s one-match ban overturned so he can play against Brentford at Old Trafford on Saturday.

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Faisant partie des grands favoris de la SaintéLyon qui se déroulera ce week-end, Baptiste Chassagne s'est confié à la Pravda.
  • Groupama Stadium ou Geoffroy-Guichard ?
  • Industry observers note that départ à Sainté ou arrivée à Lyon ?

Faisant partie des grands favoris de la SaintéLyon qui se déroulera ce week-end, Baptiste Chassagne s'est confié à la Pravda.

"Vivre à Lyon ou à Saint-Etienne ? Plutôt à Saint-Etienne. Pour les gens, pour les Stéphanois. Groupama Stadium ou Geoffroy-Guichard ? Je vais au Chaudron depuis que je suis tout petit. Je pense qu’on ne se rend pas compte de la puissance émotionnelle que ça procure d’être un supporter stéphanois et de se sentir un parmi d’autre au sein du peuple vert. Michel Platini ou Juninho ? Juninho [on mettra cette énorme faute de goût sur le compte de la jeunesse, l’ultra-trailer de 33 ans n’ayant jamais vu jouer Platoche, ndp2]. Je reste objectif, je trouve que c’est un joueur qui était très élégant. A la fois le joueur mais aussi l’homme. Tu ne peux qu’être admiratif de ses coups francs, même si franchement il a mis des lucarnes qui m’ont fait, en tant que supporter stéphanois, très mal. Chants lyonnais ou chants stéphanois ? Le chant des Magic Fans dans le Chaudron. Même si actuellement je suis abonné en Sud, j’ai été pendant quelques années en Kop Nord et quand ils lancent les chants, à nouveau c’est très puissant.

Industry observers note that départ à Sainté ou arrivée à Lyon ? L’arrivée à la Halle Tony Garnier. C’est la finalité d’une nuit qui est souvent magique. C’est pour ces émotions-là qu’on court. Sur la ligne de départ, à Sainté, il y a souvent beaucoup plus d’excitation, d’appréhension et aussi un petit peu plus de trac donc c’est toujours un peu moins agréable. Nuit noire ou lever du jour ? Nuit noire pour le coup dans les Monts du Lyonnais. La SaintéLyon, c’est une course qui est très populaire au sens où il y a beaucoup de gens qui courent. Du coup il y a un peu cet effet de masse qu’on peut ressentir. Par contre, dès qu’on se retrouve un petit peu dans les Monts du Lyonnais, dans le cœur de la course, en fait tu deviens très seul, très vite. Il y a une sorte de solitude assez forte. Et du coup il faut savoir pourquoi tu es là. C’est là raison pour laquelle il y a souvent beaucoup d’abandons chez les coureurs qui visent la performance. Parce que c’est la course de fin de saison et quand t’arrives dans la nuit noire des Monts du Lyonnais, si tu ne sais pas pourquoi t’es là, t’arrêtes.

Un verre de Côtes-du-Rhône ou une bière de la Loire ? Plutôt brunch. On a une tradition familiale. Ma petite soeur et mon petit frère courent aussi la SaintéLyon , j’ai des amis qui courent. Donc on va faire un brunch, comme d’habitude, vers midi 13h00, ensuite on fera une petite sieste et certainement qu’on ira boire une bière après. A l’arrivée, une écharpe de l’OL ou une écharpe de l’ASSE ? Je ne brandis aucune écharpe. Je suis très fier d’être supporter stéphanois mais je sais que c’est quelque chose qui pourrait être mal perçu. Entre le chambrage et la bêtise, la frontière, parfois, elle est fine. Donc voilà, je n’ai pas du tout envie d’alimenter ce débat-là. Ce sont deux très belles villes et la course, en fait, c’est un trait d’union entre ces deux villes.".

L’ex portiere spiega anche perché non frequenta i social e quale momento degli allenamenti gli manca.

According to recent reports, secondo quanto riportato da La Repubblica, Angelo Peruzzi ha smesso di fare il dirigente della Lazio perché non si divertiva più. Lo racconta in un’intervista a La Repubblica: «Sono stato dirigente della Lazio, poi ho smesso: non mi divertivo più.».

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

According to recent reports, peruzzi oggi vive lontano dalle apparizioni televisive. «Vivo a Blera, il mio paese in provincia di Viterbo, mi piace la campagna e stare tranquillo. Non mi annoio, le giornate volano, la vita vola», dice parlando delle sue giornate.

Alla domanda sul perché il calcio non gli piaccia più, Peruzzi risponde: «Non sputo nel piatto dove ho mangiato per tanto tempo, però mi domando cosa sia rimasto dentro quel piatto. Passione, a occhio poca».

Il discorso si sposta sul rapporto tra calciatori e pubblico. Peruzzi ricorda che, quando giocava, non amava concedere interviste: riteneva impossibile dire la verità senza avere problemi e pensava che questo portasse a risposte banali o a essere considerati stupidi. Poi parla dei social, assenti ai suoi tempi: «Quando giocavo, non amavo le interviste perché dire la verità era impossibile, troppe grane. E allora si diventa banali o si passa per stupidi. E non esistevano i social, questi strumenti spaventosi che hanno stravolto le nostre vite. Io non li frequento: perché mai dovrei raccontare a tutti cosa ho mangiato a colazione?».

According to recent reports, C'est une annonce pour le moins inattendue dans le monde du sport tricolore. Ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, Teddy Riner a officialisé sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027 dans une vidéo publiée sur son compte X, tout en lançant son propre mouvement politique intitulé « La France qu'on veut ».

Industry observers note that le judoka français de 37 ans se lance ainsi en politique après avoir dominé le judo international. Quintuple champion olympique et onze fois champion du monde, Teddy Riner a bâti un palmarès exceptionnel qui le place au sommet de sa discipline. Alors que son avenir sportif restait au cœur des discussions depuis les Jeux de Paris, le Français surprend en ouvrant un tout autre chapitre personnel. Un virage spectaculaire.

Sources indicate that dans une vidéo publiée ce lundi 9 novembre 2026 sur son compte X, Teddy Riner a pris la parole face caméra afin de lever le voile sur ses intentions pour la prochaine présidentielle. Le judoka de 37 ans a officialisé sa démarche avec des mots simples et directs.

Conscient des réactions que son entrée en politique peut susciter, le quintuple champion olympique a tenu à devancer immédiatement les critiques concernant son manque d'expérience dans les fonctions publiques. Teddy Riner a ainsi déclaré : « Je sais ce qu'on va dire de moi. Il est fou, il n'est pas du sérail, il n'a pas les codes, il n'a jamais fait de politique. Mais posez-vous la question avec moi, qu'est-ce qui est fou aujourd'hui ? Je n'ai pas passé ma vie derrière un public, mais le combat a toujours fait partie de moi. » Une détermination affichée.

Sources indicate that pour concrétiser ses ambitions, le judoka français de 37 ans a également fondé sa propre formation politique ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, baptisée « La France qu'on veut ». Cette prise de parole sur les réseaux sociaux a d'ailleurs été accompagnée d'un entretien accordé au quotidien Le Parisien pour préciser le sens de sa démarche. Dans cet échange, Teddy Riner revendique une volonté de rassemblement sans affiliation partisane, affirmant vouloir devenir un « président qui fédère » sans se situer à droite ou à gauche.

En effet, le champion tricolore a expliqué que sa décision avait mûri dans le sillage direct de l'élan collectif suscité par les Jeux olympiques de Paris 2024. Porté par cette dynamique populaire, il entend désormais transposer cette ferveur sur le blueprint politique. Ainsi, son mouvement politique refuse d'entrer dans les clivages traditionnels pour privilégier une adhésion commune à l'échelle du pays. Un projet ambitieux.

Recent findings suggest that toutefois, cette ambition politique ne pousse pas Teddy Riner vers la retraite sportive. Sur le plan des compétitions, sa dernière apparition individuelle remonte aux Jeux olympiques de Paris en août 2024, suivie d'une participation sous les couleurs du PSG Judo en Ligue des champions en décembre 2024. Malgré cette nouvelle démarche politique, le quintuple champion olympique et onze fois champion du monde de judo demeure bel et bien un athlète en activité.

In a recent development, au-delà de l'élection présidentielle de 2027, Teddy Riner a ainsi fait part de son souhait de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Los Angeles 2028 si ses futures responsabilités et les Français le lui permettent. Le judoka français lie donc son avenir sportif à la suite de son engagement public, avec en ligne de mire les Jeux olympiques de Los Angeles 2028.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Auteur de son premier but dans l'élite lors du match nul sur le terrain sarthois, Mamadou Coulibaly a suscité une vive polémique en mimant un geste d'égorgement. Le jeune milieu de l'AS Monaco se retrouve désormais sous la menace directe d'une lourde suspension.

Dimanche 8 novembre 2026, l'AS Monaco a été accrochée sur la pelouse du Mans FC (1-1) pour le compte de la 10e journée de Ligue 1. Si le club du Rocher espérait engranger des points précieux, la rencontre a été marquée par le geste de son joueur de 22 ans.

Titularisé dans l'entrejeu monégasque, Mamadou Coulibaly pensait passer une bonne soirée après avoir ouvert le score à la 40e minute de jeu. Mais la joie d'inscrire son tout premier but en Ligue 1 a rapidement viré au malaise lors de sa célébration. Le milieu monégasque s'est en effet dirigé vers le poteau de corner pour glisser sur les genoux, avant de tirer la langue et de mimer un geste d'égorgement avec son pouce sous la gorge. Un geste polémique.

Ce geste n'est malheureusement pas inédit en Principauté cette saison. En effet, cette célébration reproduit à l'identique celle effectuée par son partenaire de club Paris Brunner face à Strasbourg en septembre dernier, lors de la 4e journée de Ligue 1. Pour ce geste, le jeune attaquant avait été sanctionné par la commission de discipline de la LFP de quatre matches de suspension, dont deux fermes et deux avec sursis.

Industry observers note that D'ailleurs, cette récidive au sein du même effectif met le joueur dans une situation extrêmement délicate. En raison de ce précédent disciplinaire très récent, Mamadou Coulibaly risque une sanction similaire d'au moins deux matches de suspension ferme devant la commission de discipline de la LFP. L'instance disciplinaire devrait se saisir rapidement du dossier pour trancher sur ce comportement. Un coup dur en perspective.

In a recent development, conscient des remous provoqués par son geste, le joueur de 22 ans s'est exprimé devant les journalistes à l'concern de la rencontre. « Je tiens à m’excuser parce que j’ai cru comprendre que ça avait été mal compris. C’est un geste que j’ai fait par rapport un ami à moi qui m’a conseillé au sujet de la célébration. Je tiens à m'excuser si ça a pu heurter des gens. Maintenant, ce sont des choses qui se font dans d'autres championnats, je n'ai pas pensé que ça pourrait avoir des conséquences négatives », a ainsi déclaré Mamadou Coulibaly en zone mixte au micro des médias après Le Mans-Monaco.

Toutefois, cette justification risque de ne pas suffire auprès de son entraîneur Filipe Luis. Le coach monégasque avait pourtant publiquement averti son groupe en septembre après l'affaire similaire, insistant sur l'exemplarité attendue : « Il a fait une erreur. Il l'a compris tout de suite. Il s'est excusé. Le club prend cette affaire très au sérieux (…). On espère que ça ne se reproduira plus », avait prévenu le technicien en conférence de presse. Au-delà de cette polémique extra-sportive, l'AS Monaco accueillera l'AJ Auxerre au stade Louis-II le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 20h45 pour la 11e journée de Ligue 1.

Toutefois, l'institution allemande, championne de Bundesliga en 2009 et installée dans l'élite sans discontinuer depuis 1997, a été reléguée en mai 2026 lors d'un barrage contre Paderborn (0-0, 2-1 a.p.). Un coup dur pour la formation allemande. Resté fidèle au club en 2. Bundesliga, Kumbedi est rapidement devenu un titulaire indiscutable sous les ordres de Tobias Strobl, malgré une blessure musculaire lui ayant fait manquer trois matches.

  • Le World 11 masculin 2026 a été configuré selon un schéma tactique très offensif, comprenant un gardien, trois défenseurs, trois milieux et quatre attaquants.
  • Défenseurs : Pau Cubarsí (FC Barcelone), Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint-Germain), Nuno Mendes (Paris Saint-Germain).
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, le World 11 masculin de la FIFPRO a été officiellement dévoilé pour récompenser les meilleurs joueurs de la planète. Trois joueurs de Ligue 1 sont présents dans l'équipe idéale de l'année... trois joueurs du Paris Saint-Germain !

Le World 11 masculin 2026 a été configuré selon un schéma tactique très offensif, comprenant un gardien, trois défenseurs, trois milieux et quatre attaquants. Cette formation réunit plusieurs têtes d'affiche du football continental :.

Défenseurs : Pau Cubarsí (FC Barcelone), Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint-Germain), Nuno Mendes (Paris Saint-Germain).

Milieux : Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), Rodri (FC Barcelone), Vitinha (Paris Saint-Germain).

Attaquants : Erling Haaland (Manchester City), Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid), Lionel Messi (Inter Miami), Lamine Yamal (FC Barcelone).

Dans ce secteur offensif de gala, Kylian Mbappé s'impose comme l'unique footballeur français récompensé cette année. À ses côtés, Lionel Messi retrouve le World 11 masculin pour la première fois depuis 2023, enregistrant au passage sa 18e nomination. De son côté, le phénomène Lamine Yamal se paye le luxe d'établir un record en devenant le premier joueur à obtenir deux apparitions dans le onze de la FIFPRO avant ses 20 ans. Un record de précocité.

According to recent reports, au tableau des nations, l'Espagne s'affirme comme le pays le plus représenté dans ce onze avec quatre éléments plébiscités, à savoir David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri et Lamine Yamal. La sélection espagnole porte ainsi son total à 53 apparitions dans le FIFPRO World 11 masculin.

À l'échelle des clubs, le Paris Saint-Germain et le FC Barcelone sont les clubs les plus représentés du scrutin masculin. Le club parisien compte en effet trois lauréats avec les deux défenseurs latéraux Achraf Hakimi et Nuno Mendes, ainsi que le milieu de terrain Vitinha. Le FC Barcelone installe de son côté Lamine Yamal, Rodri et Pau Cubarsí, qui bénéficient logiquement du sacre de l'Espagne lors de la Coupe du monde.

According to recent reports, de son côté, le Real Madrid place deux joueurs majeurs dans cette formation idéale avec Jude Bellingham et Kylian Mbappé. L'institution madrilène comptait d'ailleurs au départ cinq nommés potentiels dans les listes globales : Thibaut Courtois, Marc Cucurella, Jude Bellingham et Kylian Mbappé chez les hommes, ainsi qu'Athenea del Castillo chez les femmes.

It has been revealed that cette distinction annuelle tire sa valeur de son mode de désignation, où les joueurs jugent directement leurs pairs sur l'ensemble de la planète. En effet, le scrutin masculin a réuni les votes de 19 806 footballeurs professionnels évoluant dans 73 pays différents. Une participation massive. Pour départager les nombreux prétendants et intégrer l'équipe type, la FIFPRO a appliqué une grille d'évaluation rigoureuse dès l'ouverture des votes.

Ainsi, la période de référence retenue pour analyser le rendement sur le terrain s'est étendue du 4 août 2025 au 19 juillet 2026 inclus. Au-delà des seules prestations sportives, une condition éliminatoire imposait aux nommés d'avoir disputé au minimum 30 matches officiels au cours de cet exercice.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that L'Olympique Lyonnais a officialisé ce lundi 9 novembre 2026 à 18h la nomination de Carlos Vicens au poste d'entraîneur principal. Libre depuis son licenciement du SC Braga, le technicien espagnol de 43 ans s'est engagé pour un an et demi, soit jusqu'au 30 juin 2028, avec pour objectif principal de décrocher une qualification européenne en mai prochain.

Industry observers note that pour relancer l'équipe, la direction de l'OL a choisi de miser sur un profil au bagage formateur reconnu. En effet, avant son expérience au Portugal, Carlos Vicens a passé huit saisons au sein de Manchester City. Vainqueur de la FA Youth Cup en 2020 avec les U18 du club anglais, l'Espagnol est ensuite devenu l'adjoint de Pep Guardiola entre 2021 et 2025. Un passage formateur au plus haut niveau.

Industry observers note that fort de cette riche expérience, le nouvel entraîneur lyonnais s'était ensuite lancé comme numéro un au SC Braga lors de la saison 2025-2026. Une aventure réussie avec une quatrième place en championnat portugais et une demi-finale de Ligue Europa, avant un licenciement survenu le 20 octobre 2026 après trois défaites consécutives.

Sources indicate that dans son communiqué, le club rhodanien explique son choix : « La direction a ainsi retenu le profil de Carlos Vicens, dont l'approche du jeu, l'exigence et l'importance accordée au développement des joueurs correspondent pleinement aux orientations définies par le club ». Cette arrivée met un terme au feuilleton de la succession sur le banc rhodanien. L'OL devait en effet trouver un remplaçant à Paulo Fonseca, récemment parti pour le Sporting CP après 83 matches dirigés à Lyon, contre une indemnité estimée à 5 millions d'euros. Durant cette période délicate, Jorge Maciel avait assuré l'intérim. Toutefois, les difficultés sportives ont rapidement ressurgi en championnat.

In a recent development, après un match nul contre la Real Sociedad (1-1) en Ligue Europa, les Lyonnais se sont inclinés à Brest (0-2) dimanche 8 novembre 2026 lors de la 10e journée de Ligue 1. Une rencontre disputée en Bretagne pendant laquelle Carlos Vicens a visité les installations du club. L'Espagnol a ainsi découvert son futur cadre de travail avant de parapher son contrat de dix-huit mois.

Pour mener à bien sa mission, Carlos Vicens est accompagné par quatre adjoints, dont son assistant Mario Enguidanos (34 ans) et Lander Iza Garcia (30 ans), chargé de la performance. Dans un souci de continuité, le club a également maintenu des cadres techniques déjà en place : « Jorge Maciel conservera ses fonctions d'entraîneur adjoint, dans une volonté de continuité et avec la pleine confiance de la direction du club. Adrien Tarascon poursuivra également sa mission de responsable du développement individuel des joueurs, tandis que Sébastien Hamel, jusqu'ici entraîneur des gardiens de la Pro 2 depuis janvier 2025, rejoindra définitivement le staff. ».

Industry observers note that le technicien espagnol n'aura que peu de temps pour prendre ses marques. Carlos Vicens dirigera sa première séance d'entraînement mardi 10 novembre au matin avant d'être présenté aux médias à 15 heures. Au-delà des présentations, le travail tactique débutera sans attendre. Le premier match officiel de Carlos Vicens avec l'OL aura lieu le samedi 21 novembre 2026 face au LOSC au stade Pierre-Mauroy lors de la 11e journée de Ligue 1.

According to recent reports, invité au micro de Juanma Castaño dans l'émission nocturne El Partidazo de COPE, diffusée sur la station Cadena COPE dans la nuit du 9 au 10 novembre 2026, Marc Cucurella a placé le club madrilène comme la meilleure équipe d'Europe. Industry observers note that dans ce même entretien, l'international espagnol a également pris la défense de son coéquipier Vinícius Júnior face aux critiques. D'ailleurs, Marc Cucurella a tenu à mettre en avant Arda Güler, qu'il considère comme le joueur madrilène le plus impressionnant cette saison.

Interrogé sur la concurrence européenne et plus particulièrement sur le statut du PSG, le défenseur a placé sans hésiter le Real Madrid devant le club français. Tout en reconnaissant la solidité du projet et la qualité évidente de l'effectif du PSG, il voit l'équipe madrilène un cran au-dessus en ce moment. Une hiérarchie assumée. Toutefois, le joueur a reconnu avec franchise ne pas regarder les matches du club parisien ni son duel face au FC Barcelone, par manque de temps et pour s'occuper de ses enfants.

Sources indicate that une vie de famille bien remplie qui l'éloigne des matches à la télévision, mais qui ne l'empêche pas de maintenir une analyse tranchée sur le rapport de force actuel. Ainsi, malgré les louanges adressées au club de la capitale française, le joueur maintient fermement sa position en faveur du Real Madrid.

Régulièrement aligné avec l'équipe d'Espagne, le latéral gauche prépare un rendez-vous key en Ligue des nations. La Roja disputera en effet la cinquième journée de la compétition le jeudi 12 novembre 2026 sur le terrain de la République tchèque.

Après cette parenthèse internationale, le Real Madrid retrouvera le championnat. Le prochain rendez-vous en club du Real Madrid aura lieu le samedi 21 novembre 2026 au stade Santiago-Bernabéu face au Celta Vigo, à l'occasion d'une nouvelle journée de Liga.

It has been revealed that mis à la porte par l'écurie Haas avec effet immédiat, Esteban Ocon a pris la parole ce mardi 10 novembre 2026. Le pilote français a tenu à adresser un message sobre à ses supporters ainsi qu'à l'ensemble du paddock de la Formule 1.

Cette prise de parole intervient une semaine après l'officialisation de son éviction, actée le mardi 3 novembre 2026 pour les quatre derniers Grands Prix de la saison 2026. Une rupture brutale alors qu'Esteban Ocon, 30 ans, occupait la 16e place du classement des pilotes avec 7 points, contre 20 points pour son coéquipier Oliver Bearman.

Industry observers note that sur son compte Instagram, le vainqueur du Grand Prix de Hongrie 2021 a publié un texte sobre, sans la moindre rancœur envers sa direction. Esteban Ocon a préféré remercier chaleureusement les personnes qui l'ont soutenu durant cette épreuve, rappelant son attachement indéfectible pour sa discipline.

Le pilote tricolore compte 199 engagements et 198 départs en Formule 1, ainsi que 4 podiums en carrière.

L'aventure s'est pourtant terminée dans la tourmente. En effet, tout s'est accéléré le samedi 31 octobre 2026 lors du Grand Prix de Mexico sur le circuit de l'Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Mis à l'écart soudainement après un différend interne lors des essais libres du vendredi, le Français avait alors cédé sa place au réserviste japonais Ryo Hirakawa. Un coup dur.

Toutefois, le directeur de l'écurie, Ayao Komatsu, a affirmé avoir pris cette décision anticipée dans le meilleur intérêt de la structure. Haas a d'ailleurs aligné le rookie brésilien Rafael Câmara, déjà engagé pour 2027, dès le Grand Prix de São Paulo le week-end du 8 novembre 2026.

Désormais sur la touche, Esteban Ocon fait face à un futur incertain. À trois manches de la fin de la saison 2026, il ne dispose d'aucun baquet titulaire confirmé pour 2027. Au-delà des doutes contractuels, sa passion et son amour pour la Formule 1 restent aussi forts que jamais.

Le prochain rendez-vous du championnat du monde de Formule 1 2026 sera le Grand Prix de Las Vegas, 21e manche de la saison, programmé du 19 au 21 novembre 2026 sur le Las Vegas Strip Circuit.

The Women's World Cup is coming home... but 2035 cannot be treated as a fix for the game's problems, writes TARA ANSON-WALSH

💡 Key Takeaways

  • The United Kingdom will host the 2035 Women's World Cup, the first football World Cup to be staged on these shores since 1966, it was announced to much fanfare on Monday.
  • Yet while the countdown can now officially begin, the biggest challenges facing the women's game cannot be kicked eight-and-a-half years down the road.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By TARA ANSON-WALSH, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 14:36 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 17:04 EST, 23 November 2026.

The United Kingdom will host the 2035 Women's World Cup, the first football World Cup to be staged on these shores since 1966, it was announced to much fanfare on Monday.

Yet while the countdown can now officially begin, the biggest challenges facing the women's game cannot be kicked eight-and-a-half years down the road.

Over in Zurich, FIFA president Gianni Infantino undertook his usual long-winded and self-serving monologue which precedes these ceremonies, in which he heralded the 'incredible growth' of the Women's World Cup, describing a time when they 'didn't exist'.

'We all remember the last Women's World Cup,' the embattled 56-year-old Italian stated, calling it 'a huge success'.

The irony, of course, is that the last Women's World Cup in Australia and Newly introduced Zealand is remembered by many for all the wrong reasons, with newspaper back pages peppered with images of Spain captain Jenni Hermoso's kiss with the former president of Spain's FA, Luis Rubiales, for days after the final.

Rubiales was later convicted of sexual assault for the incident, which triggered widespread protests across the country and overshadowed Spain's terrific 1-0 triumph over England in Sydney.

Gianni Infantino undertook his usual long-winded and self-serving monologue which precedes these ceremonies, in which he heralded the 'incredible growth' of the Women's World Cup.

Rubiales was later convicted of sexual assault for the incident, which triggered widespread protests across the country and overshadowed Spain's terrific 1-0 triumph over England.

There is an added layer of irony in that Infantino had, two days before the 2023 final, angered many women worldwide with yet another controversial speech in which he told them: 'You have the power to change', but that they had to 'convince us men what we have to do'.

Alongside this patronising statement, Infantino also insisted that equal pay at the World Cup 'would not solve anything'.

Three years later, Infantino is unfortunately still at the helm, while UEFA's attempts to unseat him following his controversial bid to sell off the World Cup now look to have failed spectacularly, with the football despot increasingly likely to secure a fourth term.

Industry observers note that what the social and political landscape will look like by the time this women's footballing bonanza arrives on these shores in 2035 remains unclear. What is clear, however, is that the game's continued progress will require more than the record attendances and soaring commercial revenues the FA are predicting.

It will require the figures who have too often held it back to finally step aside, and that process should begin with the likes of Infantino being shown the door.

It will require those at the top of English football to put their heads together and work out how to stem falling attendances in the league. The average attendance across the first eight WSL matchweeks of 2024-25 was 8,173. Last season it was 7,472. This season, it is tracking at around 5,677.

And third, it will require somewhere other than Wembley to stage the final.

Wembley was, of course, the scene of Chloe Kelly's moment of madness, yet by the time the 2035 Women's World Cup comes around it will also have hosted the men's finals of Euro 2024 and 2028.

The FA paid off its debt on the national stadium in 2024, 17 years after its reopening, and is no longer obligated to host major events there to service repayments.

The rules have been left open for another venue to emerge to host the final, such as Man United's proposed new 100,000 stadium.

While under current FIFA regulations, Wembley is the only one of the proposed 22 stadiums that meets the requirements to host a final, the rules have been left open enough for another venue to emerge should a suitable stadium be completed before 2035.

Step up Sir Jim Ratcliffe, although please refer back to point one in this regard – the Manchester United co-owner who famously asked former captain Katie Zelem 'what do you do here?' while touring the club's women's facilities.

United's proposed latest 100,000-seater stadium was included in the 2035 bid and could yet come under consideration from FIFA.

While there are still many hurdles to clear before then, hosting a tournament final in Manchester would undoubtedly be huge for the women's game, not least given the optics of a bid built around being 'all together', described as 'a rallying cry to unite people through football'.

London should not be the epicentre of the tournament, not if the intention is to spread the women's game across the United Kingdom rather than concentrate it in the capital, where Arsenal's attendances continue to dwarf those of every other WSL club.

In other words, the women's game in this country cannot be put on hold until 2035.

Industry observers note that it cannot afford to wait eight-and-a-half years for this World Cup to come and rescue it. Time to get cracking.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Libre de tout contrat depuis son départ de Manchester City en mai 2026, Pep Guardiola pourrait rapidement retrouver un banc prestigieux. La Fédération américaine de football (U.S. Soccer) a placé le technicien catalan en priorité absolue pour prendre les rênes de la sélection nationale, alors que Mauricio Pochettino se rapproche de Manchester United.

Un changement majeur se prépare outre-Atlantique. Le poste de sélectionneur des États-Unis va probablement se libérer en raison du départ imminent de Mauricio Pochettino vers Manchester United pour remplacer Michael Carrick. Selon les révélations de The Athletic, un accord verbal a été conclu ce mercredi 11 novembre 2026 entre le club mancunien et le technicien argentin, pendant que les dirigeants Omar Berrada et Jason Wilcox validaient à Monaco avec Sir Jim Ratcliffe le limogeage de Carrick.U.S. Soccer négocie désormais le départ de Pochettino avec Manchester United contre une indemnité de résiliation estimée à 10 millions de dollars, soit environ 7 millions de livres sterling.

Pour combler ce vide, les dirigeants américains ont de grandes ambitions. D'après The Athletic, la fédération américaine fait de Pep Guardiola sa priorité absolue pour succéder à Mauricio Pochettino. Le nom du technicien catalan se trouve déjà au centre de discussions en interne afin de déterminer la méthode pour le convaincre. Selon le journaliste Tom Bogert, l'instance prévoit d'initier la démarche par un appel direct au coach espagnol. Sans club depuis son départ de Manchester City en mai 2026, après dix années marquées par six titres de Premier League et une Ligue des champions, Guardiola avait déjà été approché par U.S. Soccer en 2024 puis avant la Coupe du monde 2022.

U.S. Soccer est prête à répondre aux exigences salariales très élevées du technicien catalan pour finaliser sa venue. Les décideurs américains savent également que Pep Guardiola possède une attache particulière avec les États-Unis, pour y avoir habité à New York pendant son année sabbatique en 2012 après son passage au FC Barcelone. Toutefois, convaincre l'ancien entraîneur des Cityzens reste un défi complexe. En juillet 2026, Guardiola avait ainsi décliné une offre de la fédération italienne après une rencontre à Barcelone avec Paolo Maldini et Leonardo, car il souhaitait impérativement respecter son année sabbatique à l'écart des terrains.

Industry observers note that L'argument décisif de la sélection américaine pourrait ainsi venir d'un calendrier taillé sur mesure. En effet, ce projet permettrait à Pep Guardiola de prolonger son repos, le match amical de décembre contre la Jamaïque étant réservé aux joueurs locaux, ce qui repousserait ses débuts effectifs à mars 2027. En attendant l'matter de ce feuilleton, Mauricio Pochettino dirige actuellement l'équipe américaine en Géorgie. Les États-Unis disputent leur quart de finale de Ligue des nations de la Concacaf contre Haïti, le 14 novembre à Miami pour le match aller, puis le 17 novembre 2026 à Cincinnati pour le retour, avant le ralliement attendu de l'Argentin vers Manchester.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Industry observers note that manchester United a officialisé ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026, par l'intermédiaire d'un communiqué, le limogeage avec effet immédiat de son entraîneur Michael Carrick.
  • Arrivé au centre d'entraînement de Carrington à 7h50 ce jeudi matin, Michael Carrick n'aura pas passé beaucoup de temps avec ses joueurs.
  • Pour justifier ce choix fort, la direction mancunienne a publié un communiqué sans détour.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that manchester United a officialisé ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026, par l'intermédiaire d'un communiqué, le limogeage avec effet immédiat de son entraîneur Michael Carrick. Plongée dans une crise sportive historique, la direction mancunienne a décidé d'agir sans attendre la fin de la semaine pour redresser la situation.

Arrivé au centre d'entraînement de Carrington à 7h50 ce jeudi matin, Michael Carrick n'aura pas passé beaucoup de temps avec ses joueurs. Le technicien de 45 ans a définitivement quitté les installations du club vers 10h18 après avoir été notifié de son renvoi. Une matinée particulièrement expéditive pour l'Anglais. Michael Carrick a en effet été informé en personne de cette décision par le directeur général Omar Berrada et le directeur du football Jason Wilcox. Ce dénouement fait suite directe à un sommet crucial tenu la veille à Monaco entre Sir Jim Ratcliffe et la famille Glazer, réunis par visioconférence pour sceller définitivement le sort de leur manager.

Pour justifier ce choix fort, la direction mancunienne a publié un communiqué sans détour.

Industry observers note that le dernier match de Michael Carrick sur le banc s'est soldé par un match nul spectaculaire (4-4) arraché in extremis contre Aston Villa à Old Trafford dimanche 8 novembre 2026. Un ultime sursaut qui n'a pas suffi à sauver sa place. Manchester United pointe actuellement à une inquiétante 18e place de Premier League en position de relégable, avec un bilan de 8 points et une seule victoire en 10 journées, décrochée fin août face à Ipswich. C'est tout simplement le pire début de saison du club en 40 ans.

It has been revealed that pourtant, le redressement opéré par le technicien avait suscité de grands espoirs quelques mois plus tôt. Nommé sur le banc mancunien en janvier 2026 en succession de Rúben Amorim, Michael Carrick avait hissé l'équipe à la 3e place en remportant 12 de ses 17 derniers matches de la saison 2025-2026. Michael Carrick avait d'ailleurs prolongé son contrat au mois de mai 2026 à la suite de cette qualification en Ligue des champions, avant que la situation ne s'effondre en ce début d'exercice.

Dans son communiqué officiel, le club anglais a également précisé ses intentions pour la suite immédiate de la saison.

D'après les révélations de la presse européenne, Mauricio Pochettino fait figure de grand favori pour s'installer sur le banc et disposerait d'un accord verbal pour succéder à Michael Carrick. L'Argentin, actuellement sélectionneur des États-Unis, n'est toutefois pas encore officiellement nommé. Manchester United doit d'abord s'acquitter d'une clause libératoire estimée à près de 10 millions de dollars, soit environ 9 millions d'euros, afin de libérer le technicien de son contrat américain.

In a recent development, S'il venait à prendre les commandes de l'équipe première, Mauricio Pochettino deviendrait ainsi le 12e entraîneur de Manchester United depuis le départ de Sir Alex Ferguson en 2013. Un chantier colossal attend le futur manager. Le prochain match de Manchester United est programmé le dimanche 22 novembre 2026 à Anfield face à Liverpool pour le compte de la 11e journée de Premier League.
