Xabi Alonso hits out at ‘soft’ Chelsea players

📅 12 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 23 min read (4618 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~23 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.
  • Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.
  • Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Xabi Alonso accused his Chelsea players of being “soft” after they failed to keep a clean sheet for the 20th successive Premier League game.

Chelsea threw away an early lead to draw 2-2 with Hull City and have conceded two or more goals in each of their four Premier League games.

Alonso has tried different systems and different players in those games, but suggested Chelsea’s biggest problem is mental.

The club’s dreadful clean-sheet record pre-dates him and is the first time in 65 years Chelsea have gone 20 league games without keeping the opposition out.

According to recent reports, hull’s first goal from Mohamed Belloumi came after the ball had bounced over Jorrel Hato and Alonso stated: “We need to be aware that from any situation, any team in the Premier League can hurt you. Today it was from a long ball, two bounces, the way it happened. You need to be very aware, very ready that the danger can come from any situation. If you are soft or if you are not prepared, you will get punished and we have been punished that way.”.

Chelsea have shared 30 goals with their opponents in the club’s six games in all competitions so far this season.

“Yeah, it’s all maybe entertaining, but I hope that one day you say it was a boring game and we win and we don’t give these entertaining moments,” he noted.

It has been revealed that “But, for sure, it kind of repeats some patterns that we are making. It will take time to... or it will take moments to fix them when we get the lead and you still need to be competing and not give the chance so easily for them to come back, especially in the first goal, we can do much better.

“It was too soft to give them this hope because until then we were controlling, we were creating chances. But that momentum that we had changed the mood and the score of the game, and it’s something that we need to be talking [about], we address and we will get better. But it’s having an impact on our performances at the moment.”.

It has been revealed that asked if his players have a real desire to defend and keep clean sheets, Alonso noted: “We can do better, we can do better for sure. We need to know that even when we have the lead, a very crucial part of the game is to hold together, to keep the distance, to go intense in the situations to defend. I’m sure that we can do better.

“Overall, I think that we are attacking better than defending in every part. We know that it’s a big topic and a big theme for us. For sure, it’s just four games. But the dynamic in terms of conceding, I don’t like it and we need to do much better. Open play, set-pieces, long balls, this toughness, this competitive sense, we can do better.”.

Needing three goals or more to win games is not sustainable, as Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso is finding out.

It has been revealed that this is not a problem of Alonso’s making, given Chelsea have now gone 20 Premier League games without a clean sheet. But he is certainly not improving the issue yet.

Chelsea beat Fulham with three goals and Brighton with four but left themselves far too much to do against Arsenal and were taken advantage of by Hull City, who will be slightly disappointed they did not leave Stamford Bridge with all three points.

Goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez has now conceded seven goals in three games since joining from Aston Villa, while central defender Maxence Lacroix, who joined for £52m from Crystal Palace in the summer, was relegated to the substitutes’ bench.

Martínez was at fault for Mohamed Belloumi’s second goal, but the Argentine did make a crucial save at his back post to stop substitute Mohamed-Ali Cho grabbing a winner that Chelsea could have had no complaints about.

Hull finished the game with more shots on goal than their hosts and a higher expected-goals rate. Chelsea are far too open and in some ways far too entertaining.

Defensive midfielder Moisés Caicedo cannot return from injury promptly enough, but this does not feel like a problem that will be solved by one man. Alonso needs to find a balance and instil a real desire in his team to defend.

Caicedo has that desire, but there are no defenders at the club who have shown that absolute desperation to keep the ball out of the net that Chelsea fans became so used to in the days of John Terry, Gary Cahill and César Azpilicueta.

None of this should diminish Hull’s performance. They were not only spirited and full of character but also indicated quality and a threat. The joke is at the moment on those who laughed at their hopes of survival before a ball had been kicked.

It is now two wins and two draws for Sergej Jakirovic’s team and they are already a fifth of the way to 40 points. Jakirovic had promised his staff a week off in the international break if they reached eight points after five games. With that target already met, there may be a new reward if Hull can make it 11 points against Newcastle United next weekend.

“Before the season, I stated to my staff that we will take seven, eight points in these first five and then I will give them seven days off,” Jakirovic said. “That was our target and now we are in a very good position, eight points.

According to recent reports, “Especially today, it’s very, very difficult to play here, and now we will try to get even more. Of course, I’m a little bit worried about the international break because we have 13 national team players. But we will see who will come back and in what condition. So this is my concern right now.” Asked if his staff’s seven-day break will be extended if Hull can beat Newcastle, Jakirovic added: “I will tell them. But I know already.”.

Recent findings suggest that while his five-game target may need modifying, Jakirovic is not deviating from his goal for the season for Hull. “Our target is always to stay in the league and collect as many points as possible,” he stated. “Forty points, 38 to 41, this is the average we need. Then it’s easier to play. You can play more relaxed, with more joy and happiness. So [get to] this as soon as possible, so that we are safe.”.

Recent findings suggest that hull had not conceded a league goal before this and there had been predictions they might crumble when they finally let the ball into their net. They did so after just seven minutes but they kept their heads and came back stronger.

It was far too easy for Morgan Rogers to make a yard of space for himself to shoot after collecting the ball from João Pedro, and Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis may not have been happy to have been beaten at his near post.

Chelsea have now scored inside the first 10 minutes in all of their four league games, but Hull were in no mood to crumble and hit back with two goals in six minutes from Belloumi to take a half-time lead. Both Hull goals were shockers from Chelsea’s perspective. The first, in the 28th minute, came as a result of Jorrel Hato letting the ball bounce over him from a Ryan Giles cross and Belloumi finished brilliantly.

In a recent development, belloumi’s second came after Martínez had flapped at a corner and Semi Ajayi had hit the bar with a header. The ball fell to Belloumi again and his shot was deflected into the net.

It was no surprise that Hato did not reappear for the second half, as he was replaced by Pep Chavarría at left-back. But Chelsea remained vulnerable and Martínez had to recover from spilling a Regan Slater shot to prevent Ollie McBurnie extending Hull’s advantage.

When Palmer and Pedro combined for Pedro to sweep the ball into the net and equalise with 24 minutes remaining, it seemed like it would be Chelsea who would provide the grandstand finish.

But it was Hull who got a second wind and Chelsea were indebted to Martínez for making a save to stop Cho securing all three points and sending the visiting fans home even happier.

It has been revealed that I feel good. We have to be happy. It’s a huge result for us.

Industry observers note that we had 2-1 at half-time and we had a 100 per cent chance with McBurnie but Martinez’s save was excellent. We have to control play better in the box because we can stop this [Chelsea goal]. We had an excellent chance for Cho – Martinez saved again. Player of the match.

We can be very happy. We took a point in a very demanding match.

Eight points against very difficult opponents. We have to continue like this.

There have been 12 Premier League games at Anfield in 2026, Liverpool have only won 4 of them to date. This was seventh draw and Fulham deserves their share of the spoils. This was very much a learning experience for Andoni Iraola.

Not a single home win in the Premier League, today.

Aston Villa 1 Nottingham Forest 2Bournemouth 2 Brentford 2Chelsea 2 Hull City 2Crystal Palace 2 Ipswich Town 3Liverpool 0 Fulham 0.

What a result for Hull, who remain unbeaten and they have taken five points from fixtures against United, Villa and Chelsea.

That is the first really poor result of the Alonso era, points dropped.

What a thriller in SE25, both teams have been going for it in the closing stages, but Ipswich have surely score the winner through Zian Flemming.

Sources indicate that fulham were pointless before this game, but they have kept a clean sheet at Anfield with a disciplined display and they could well have score one or two. Underwhelming for Liverpool, who have not won just one of their first four games and their fixtures have not been the most taxing.

Recent findings suggest that and as we predicted at the beginning of the game... Liverpool 0 Fulham 0. If this reporter ever gives you advice on a horse to back or a team to follow, make sure you take the opposite stance. Fulham deserve their reward and their fans are singing “We got a point!”.

Villa are finishing the game with 10 men because Ian Maatsen pulled up after Emery had made his five substitutions, and Forest have punished them through Igor Jesus with just a few minutes of normal time to play.

In a recent development, alexander Isak heads over the bar when he perhaps should have hit the target. Has time run out for Liverpool?

You might imagine Chelsea are battering down the door, but Mohamed-Ali Cho has just forced Emi Martinez into a save at the other end. Hull will remain unbeaten if they can hold out.

Strand Larsen has had his critics, but he has scored his first goal of the season to set up a grandstand finish with 15 minutes plus stoppage time to play at Selhurst Park.

Short corner, McGinn whipped in an inswinging cross that is glanced into the bottom corner by Alysson.

According to recent reports, liverpool continue to toil at Anfield, but no opening goal. Iraola has thrown on Frimpong, Mac Allister, Ngumoha and Gakpo in the second half. Fulham have had the chances to score at least one, and Josh King has just brought a save out of Alisson.

Sources indicate that hull are a little lucky they still have 11 men on the pitch. Already on a booking, my man Crooks bundled down Rogers. It could easily have been another yellow car but the referee let him off and now he’s been replaced by Iroegbunam.

Joao Pedro finds the smallest of gaps to be the goalkeeper and find the roof of the net with a brilliant, instinctive finish.

In a recent development, that had not really been coming for Chelsea. It all felt a bit easy for Palmer to get his low cross into the box and Pedro to sweep the ball in. The home fans have woken up again.

Martinez was lucky to get away with another slip up, there. He spilt Slater’s shot but reacted before McBurnie to stop the Hull striker scoring the rebound. Just a day after his nasty looking crash, Sorba Thomas is on for Hull.

This game is absolutely here for Fulham to win. Quietness has descended around Anfield, the hosts have no fluency in their play and Fulham are growing in confidence. Why wouldn’t they after getting to 65 minutes with a clean sheet?

Just like in the first half, four minutes after one of these teams taking the lead there has been an equaliser. Kevin Scahde is in a rich vein of form.

Industry observers note that bournemouth have have never beaten Brentford in the Premier League, but they might well be on their way to changing that record having trailed earlier in the game. Marcus Tavernier has just scored their second goal.

It has been revealed that matt Davidson Rider Crooks has just been booked for a very cynical foul on Rogers. It gave Chelsea a free-kick in a dangerous position Reece James had an effort tipped away. Chelsea have started the second half well.

Within a minute of the restart, Villa lose the ball in midfield and Delap punishes them to the maximum. Cracking finish from just outside the box, and a much-needed goal by Delap. The Glasner curse striking for Emery again?

Liam Delap has just started paying back that £50m transfer fee with a fine goal.

Delap picked the ball up on the left and set himself up on the edge of the box before crashing a 25-yard shot past Zion Suzuki.

Unai Emery has made a couple of changes at half-time, taking off Nicolas Jackson who picked up a silly booking just before half-time.

Tammy Abraham is on in his place. George Hemmings is also off and replaced by Alysson.

Pep Chavarria on for Chelsea at half-time. He’s replaced Jorrel Hato, who had a bit of a stinker in the first half.

Recent findings suggest that andoni Iraola hasn’t hung about here. Milos Kerkez has come on immediately after half-time for Kostas Tsimikas and you can say with certainty that Liverpool will be shopping for a upcoming left-back in due course.

So at half-time, Hull City are top of the Premier League and don’t their supporters know it? They were singing “we are top of the League” for the full two minutes of time added on for stoppages at the end of the first period. Alonso has some work to do at the break.

Forest did need a brilliant double save from Matz Sels to deny Victor Lindelof and have recovered to slow the match down.

Neco Williams wasted a decent chance for Forest from outside the penalty area shortly before the break.

Referee Andrew Madley has irritated both teams with a number of weird decisions - but that’s sadly par for the course with officials nowadays.

Villa 0 Forest 0Bournemouth 1 Brentford 1Chelsea 1 Hull City 2Palace 1 Ipswich 2Liverpool 0 Fulham 0.

Since Glasner’s arrival in English football with Crystal Palace in February 2024, he has faced Emery’s Villa seven times and never lost.

With five victories and two draws, it is an impressive record albeit with a different set of players.

Aston Villa and Forest are two teams in transition, and meet for the first time since that two-legged Europa League semi-final last season.

Villa are building a upcoming chapter after a summer of significant change, while Forest are implementing a totally different style of play under Oliver Glasner.

There have been signs of progress at both of the former European Cup winners. Villa secured an impressive victory over Club Brugge in the Champions League on Tuesday. Forest are improving under Glasner, with their best performance the 2-2 draw at Liverpool.

Aston Villa’s rocky start to the campaign took a turn for the better with a 3-2 Champions League victory at Club Brugge, and as the weeks go by Unai Emery’s team should grow stronger as their raft of young signings bed in. Après 7 défaites en 10 matchs de Premier League, c'est désormais officiel : Crystal Palace vire Pierre Sage !

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • It has been revealed that moins de cinq mois après sa nomination à Crystal Palace, Pierre Sage a été officiellement démis de ses fonctions ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026.
  • Pierre Sage n'aura pas résisté au revers concédé à domicile contre Liverpool (1-3), le dimanche 8 novembre 2026 à Selhurst Park, signant une quatrième défaite de rang en championnat.
  • La situation n'était guère plus brillante sur la scène continentale.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that moins de cinq mois après sa nomination à Crystal Palace, Pierre Sage a été officiellement démis de ses fonctions ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026. L'entraîneur français de 47 ans paie un début de saison désastreux en Premier League, laissant le club londonien à la dernière place du championnat.

Pierre Sage n'aura pas résisté au revers concédé à domicile contre Liverpool (1-3), le dimanche 8 novembre 2026 à Selhurst Park, signant une quatrième défaite de rang en championnat. En dix journées de Premier League sous les ordres de Pierre Sage, le bilan comptable est accablant avec 7 défaites, 1 match nul et seulement 2 victoires, soit 7 petits points pris sur 30 possibles. Crystal Palace occupe ainsi la 20e et dernière place du classement, à deux longueurs du premier non-relégable. Une situation critique.

La situation n'était guère plus brillante sur la scène continentale. En Ligue Europa, les Eagles pointent au 21e rang de la phase de ligue avec une seule victoire en quatre rencontres. Au total, Pierre Sage n'aura dirigé que 16 matches sur le banc de Crystal Palace toutes compétitions confondues avant son licenciement.

It has been revealed that sur le terrain, la méthode du coach français n'a jamais fonctionné. L'application stricte d'un bloc haut a constamment exposé son arrière-garde, faisant de Crystal Palace la pire défense d'Angleterre avec 24 buts encaissés en 10 matches de championnat. Le mandat de Pierre Sage a notamment été marqué par une lourde défaite (5-0) subie en octobre 2026 face au rival historique Brighton. Un naufrage tactique.

Sources indicate that toutefois, l'effectif a également pâti des départs estivaux non compensés de Maxence Lacroix et Marc Guéhi en défense centrale, dans un contexte de recrutement restreint par une direction plus économe. La succession d'Oliver Glasner s'annonçait d'ailleurs périlleuse, l'Autrichien étant devenu l'idole des supporters après ses victoires en FA Cup et au Community Shield en 2025, puis en Ligue Conférence, avant de rejoindre Nottingham Forest.

Cette éviction intervient alors que Pierre Sage sortait d'une saison brillante au RC Lens, couronnée du titre de meilleur entraîneur de Ligue 1, d'une victoire en Coupe de France et d'une 2e place en championnat. Selon L'Équipe, le technicien pourrait rebondir sans tarder dans le Nord. Il figure parmi les pistes explorées par les dirigeants artésiens, aux côtés de Didier Digard et Thiago Motta, pour succéder à Yannick Cahuzac, limogé en début de semaine.

De son côté, Crystal Palace négocie activement avec l'entraîneur danois Thomas Frank pour reprendre l'équipe. Les Eagles tenteront de se relancer lors de leur prochain match, programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 15h00 face à Coventry City à la Coventry Building Society Arena, pour le compte de la 11e journée de Premier League.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Sources indicate that en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore.
  • Industry observers note that L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that invité dans le podcast Kampo animé par le journaliste Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry s'est longuement livré sur les coulisses des Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. L'ancien sélectionneur de l'équipe de France olympique a révélé la détermination totale de Michael Olise pour disputer le tournoi sous le maillot tricolore.

Sources indicate that en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore. Le tournoi olympique de football n'étant pas inscrit sur les dates officielles du calendrier de la FIFA, les clubs professionnels n'avaient aucune obligation légale de libérer leurs joueurs. Cette absence de contrainte réglementaire avait grandement compliqué la tâche de Thierry Henry pour composer son groupe. Face à ces nombreux refus, Michael Olise a adopté une démarche diamétralement opposée.

Industry observers note that L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique. Alors que Gareth Southgate souhaitait le convoquer avec les A de l'équipe d'Angleterre pour disputer l'Euro 2024, Michael Olise a écarté cette opportunité pour privilégier le maillot tricolore. Le joueur a ainsi multiplié les appels téléphoniques directs avec le sélectionneur français. Dans le podcast Kampo animé par Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry a détaillé cette insistance quotidienne : « Michael, il m’appelait tous les jours pour aller aux JO, alors qu’il y avait l’équipe d’Angleterre qui le voulait pour aller au Championnat d’Europe avec les A. Il aurait pu aller à l’Euro avec l’Angleterre. Mais il m’appelait tous les jours. Son envie de jouer pour l’équipe de France était extraordinaire. Moi, je n’ai convaincu personne. ».

It has been revealed that né à Londres en 2001 d'un père nigérian et d'une mère franco-algérienne, Michael Olise disposait sur le plan sportif de plusieurs options internationales. L'attaquant était éligible pour quatre sélections nationales différentes : la France, l'Angleterre, le Nigeria et l'Algérie. Toutefois, Michael Olise a toujours accordé sa préférence absolue à l'équipe de France. Au-delà des approches anglaises, le joueur a fait preuve d'une fermeté totale au moment de quitter Crystal Palace pour rejoindre l'Allemagne.

In a recent development, recruté par le Bayern Munich pour 53 millions d'euros selon Foot Mercato, et plus de 60 millions d'euros d'après d'autres sources, il a imposé sa participation aux Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. Le joueur a ainsi pris le risque de se heurter à sa nouvelle direction bavaroise pour défendre les couleurs tricolores. Thierry Henry a salué cette prise de position au micro de Smaïl Bouabdellah : « Michael Olise aime l’équipe de France depuis qu’il est petit. Certains joueurs ne voulaient pas venir. Pas de problème, je n’en veux à personne. Mais un mec de ce calibre est venu, alors qu’il y avait le risque de s’embrouiller avec son nouveau club. Il m’a dit: 'Où je vais, je vais dire à mon club que je vais aux Jeux olympiques, c’est tout.’ On parle de Michael Olise. Mon respect pour lui est énorme. ».

It has been revealed that sur le terrain, ce choix a porté ses fruits tout au long de la compétition estivale. Titulaire lors des 6 matches du tournoi olympique, Michael Olise a compilé 2 buts et 5 passes décisives sous les ordres de Thierry Henry. Ce parcours s'est achevé par une médaille d'argent décrochée le 9 août 2024 au Parc des Princes, après une finale disputée contre l'Espagne (3-5 après prolongation).

It has been revealed that au-delà de ce bilan chiffré, Thierry Henry qualifie Michael Olise de génie qu'il ne faut pas brider. Dans le podcast Kampo, l'ancien joueur d'Arsenal a ainsi développé son analyse sur le talent de son ancien joueur : « Michael, il est à part parce qu’il pense différemment. À un moment donné, les génies, il ne faut pas essayer de les comprendre. C’est un génie ? Ah, de très loin, très très loin. (…) Est-ce que tu vas, toi, dire à un peintre comment peindre ? Pourquoi tu veux bloquer un génie ? ».

💡 Key Takeaways
  • According to recent reports, bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie.
  • In a recent development, dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux.
  • It has been revealed that dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie. Un sursaut salutaire provoqué par Zinédine Zidane, qui n'a pas hésité à hausser le ton dans le vestiaire.

In a recent development, dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Trois jours après le revers concédé face à l'Italie à San Siro, premier accroc de l'ère Zinédine Zidane, les Tricolores se devaient de réagir. Toutefois, à la pause, le score restait nul et vierge (0-0), actant un dixième match de suite sans marquer lors du premier acte. Un manque d'efficacité chronique qui a fini par agacer le sélectionneur.

It has been revealed that dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive. Le sélectionneur souhaitait corriger l'apathie collective et le manque d'agressivité à la perte du ballon constatés durant le premier acte. Une mise au point nécessaire pour relancer son équipe. Au micro de TF1 après la rencontre, le défenseur de Liverpool Jérémy Jacquet a ainsi dévoilé la teneur du discours : « Le coach nous a dit à la mi-temps qu’il trouvait qu’on n’était pas assez agressifs à la perte du ballon. On l’a bien rectifié en deuxième. […] Pour être honnête, il n’a pas gueulé, mais a haussé le ton sur nos axes de progression à la perte de balle. Pour lui, on pouvait faire mieux. Il trouvait qu’on gardait trop le ballon et voulait que l’on bouge plus. ».

De son côté, le technicien tricolore a confirmé avoir bousculé ses troupes tout en restant mesuré, préférant insister sur les ajustements tactiques exigés sur la pelouse. « Ce n'est pas la défense. C'est tous ensemble. On doit aller presser tous ensemble et quand on ne presse pas, on se resserre tous ensemble. C'est des choses qu'on doit mettre en place. On a besoin de garder le ballon. On aime courir avec ballon, sans ballon, ce n'est pas notre truc. On l'a mieux en seconde période en jouant en deux touches. On doit le répéter. Les murs n’ont pas tremblé à la mi-temps. On a rectifié des choses et c’était mieux en seconde. La réaction était très bonne », a détaillé Zinédine Zidane sur TF1.

En effet, la copie rendue au cours des quarante-cinq premières minutes a déçu le patron des Bleus. Malgré une possession de balle établie à 60 %, la France n'a jamais su emballer la rencontre, gaspillant de l'énergie à courir après le cuir tout en concédant de larges décalages. Le pressing tricolore s'est révélé particulièrement inefficace. Sur le plateau de TF1, Zinédine Zidane a ainsi exprimé sa frustration : « C'était l'objectif de se qualifier, en étant éventuellement premier. Par contre, sur le contenu, on peut être un peu perplexe, surtout dans notre pression en première mi-temps. Quand on ne voit pas certaines choses sur le terrain, on est un peu frustrés. C'est surtout dans la pression, parce qu'on laissait faire les décalages et on n'a pas été bons du tout dans notre pression. On a rectifié ça à la mi-temps et on a été meilleurs après. Ce sont des choses où on doit encore s'améliorer. Moi, je n'étais pas content, les joueurs non plus. Mais on a rectifié. ».

According to recent reports, D'ailleurs, le sélectionneur a réitéré son agacement en conférence de presse d'après-match pour cibler ce dysfonctionnement inhabituel. Pour Zinédine Zidane, son équipe a été défaillante dans sa première ligne de récupération en concédant bien trop de liberté à l'adversaire : « Ce qui n’a pas été bon, c’est notre première pression. On l’a très bien fait sur les cinq autres matchs, même contre l’Italie. En revanche, ce soir, on a été défaillants, notamment en première mi-temps. On a laissé beaucoup trop d’espaces. On a rectifié le tir en deuxième mi-temps où on a été très bons dans l’utilisation du ballon. Même si on peut encore mieux faire, parce que j’ai des joueurs de qualité qui peuvent garder le ballon. Ce sont eux (les Turcs) qui doivent courir derrière le ballon », a insisté Zinédine Zidane.

According to recent reports, au retour des vestiaires, le discours du sélectionneur a porté ses fruits. Nettement plus agressifs et tranchants en jouant en deux touches de balle, les Bleus ont rapidement trouvé la faille sur un but contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu (49e). Lancés, les Tricolores ont ensuite fait le break grâce à Éli Junior Kroupi (79e). La réduction du score tardive d'Abdülkerim Bardakcı (89e) n'a rien changé à l'concern de la rencontre (2-1). Une réaction salutaire.

Ainsi, ce succès combiné à la défaite de l'Italie contre la Belgique (1-4) permet à la France de terminer à la première place de sa poule. Les hommes de Zinédine Zidane valident officiellement leur qualification pour les quarts de finale du Final 8 de la Ligue des nations. Les Bleus connaîtront leur prochain adversaire lors du tirage au sort programmé le vendredi 20 novembre 2026 en Suisse, avant d'aborder cette double confrontation en mars 2027.

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 14:08 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 17:56 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • Jack Grealish returned to the Everton squad for the first time since being made unavailable for selection due to a breach of club discipline, and came off the bench at half-time against Brentford on Monday.
  • Sources indicate that the Manchester City loanee was punished by the club for failing to report to training sessions and missed several matches.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By LEWIS BROWNING, SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 14:08 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 17:56 EST, 23 November 2026.

Jack Grealish returned to the Everton squad for the first time since being made unavailable for selection due to a breach of club discipline, and came off the bench at half-time against Brentford on Monday.

Sources indicate that the Manchester City loanee was punished by the club for failing to report to training sessions and missed several matches. He had not featured for four games: one because of illness, then a 'breach of club discipline' and a lack of fitness thereafter.

In a recent development, he last featured on October 17, over a month ago, but returned to the match day squad to take on Brentford on Monday night – named on the substitutes' bench. He was introduced at half-time for Tyrique George, with the Toffees 2-0 down and down to 10 men after James Tarkowski's red card. They would ultimately lose 4-0.

Manager David Moyes said ahead of the game: 'He has served his punishment and we will treat him as we were treating him before.

'We will get on with things. The team is going really well at the moment and what I don't want to do is turn it into a Jack story because it shouldn't be.'.

Pushed if that suggests he will not play on Monday night, Moyes replied: 'He could easily. He is back in the squad, he is a good player. Who knows?'.

Jack Grealish (right) returned to Everton action on Monday for the first time since being punished for missing training.

He was named on the bench against Brentford, coming on for Tyrique George at half-time.

According to recent reports, everton had won their last three games and went into Monday's match sixth in the table. The result, though, was a blow as they dropped to ninth.

According to recent reports, asked what Grealish can offer, Moyes added: 'Jack can offer us a lot. I want more from him, I want him to show more than he has done. I want him to give me more assists, goals.

Sources indicate that 'But there's lots of things about him which we need and he's good at retaining the ball, giving us good possession, carrying. So we hope that he can get back to those levels and give us what we need.

'I think this time last year he was probably sitting on five or six assists so we're hoping to get that.'.

Grealish's social media apology came after he featured in a behind-closed-doors match during the international break.

'Nice to be back out there with the boys today after a few good days training!' Grealish wrote. 'I want to apologise to the fans (and) everyone at the club for not being able to help the team the last few weeks.

'I love playing for this club (and) can't wait to be back playing in front of you guys in an Everton shirt.

'See you all soon (blue heart emoji)'.

  • Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, l'équipe de France a conclu sa phase de groupes de Ligue des nations par un succès contre la Turquie (2-1), devant 42 000 spectateurs au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux.
  • À 22h40, les Bleus ont effectué un timide tour d'honneur autour du rond central plutôt qu'autour du terrain, sans plusieurs cadres dont le capitaine Kylian Mbappé qui avait déjà quitté la pelouse.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that au sortir de la victoire obtenue face à la Turquie dimanche soir à Bordeaux, Zinédine Zidane n'a pas pu débriefer la rencontre avec ses troupes dans le vestiaire. En raison des départs précipités des joueurs, le sélectionneur de l'équipe de France a dû faire l'impasse sur son discours d'après-match.

Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, l'équipe de France a conclu sa phase de groupes de Ligue des nations par un succès contre la Turquie (2-1), devant 42 000 spectateurs au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Lors de cette 6e et dernière journée, les Bleus ont marqué un premier but grâce à une réalisation contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu à la 49e minute, puis un deuxième avec Éli Junior Kroupi à la 80e minute, avant la réduction du score turque par Abdülkerim Bardakcı à la 90e minute. Le coup de sifflet final a retenti à 22h38. Une fin de soirée agitée.

À 22h40, les Bleus ont effectué un timide tour d'honneur autour du rond central plutôt qu'autour du terrain, sans plusieurs cadres dont le capitaine Kylian Mbappé qui avait déjà quitté la pelouse. D'ailleurs, la distance entre les joueurs et les tribunes lors de ce tour d'honneur a provoqué quelques sifflets de supporters français déçus.

It has been revealed that en effet, les départs se sont enchaînés à toute vitesse. Kylian Mbappé a quitté le stade Atlantique à 22h53, soit exactement quinze minutes après le coup de sifflet final, plusieurs témoins évoquant un joueur très pressé. Rayan Cherki et Malo Gusto ont ensuite quitté le stade ensemble valise à la main, suivis par Eduardo Camavinga. Une course contre la montre.

Et pour cause, la fermeture avancée de l'aéroport de Bordeaux-Mérignac imposait un timing très serré. Plusieurs avions privés étaient ainsi prévus au décollage : un jet pour Milan à 00h05 et un autre pour Madrid à 00h12. De son côté, l'avion de la Fédération Française de Football a quitté la Gironde à 1h15.

Recent findings suggest that passés en zone d'interviews, Andy Diouf et Pablo Pagis ont tous les deux confirmé l'absence de discours de Zinédine Zidane dans le vestiaire. « On n’a pas fait de discours », a déclaré Andy Diouf devant les micros. De son côté, Pablo Pagis a détaillé la gestion du sélectionneur tricolore : « Il a laissé tout le monde tranquille ».

Zinédine Zidane n'a pas retenu ses joueurs pressés en raison de la fatigue et du calendrier très serré de ce rassemblement de novembre, qui comptait deux matches en 72 heures.

Industry observers note that au-delà de cette fin de soirée au pas de course dans les couloirs du stade bordelais, les Tricolores ont validé leur qualification. Le prochain rendez-vous des Bleus de Zidane est fixé du 25 au 30 mars 2027 pour les quarts de finale aller-retour de la Ligue des nations.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • La tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour.
  • Industry observers note that présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that ciblé par de vives critiques après la récente défaite du Brésil, Carlo Ancelotti a réagi ce lundi avec une fermeté inhabituelle. Le sélectionneur de la Seleção a sèchement répondu aux attaques de Romario, qui réclamait publiquement son départ immédiat.

La tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour. Alors que les Japonais menaient rapidement grâce à Takefusa Kubo et Keito Nakamura, le doublé de Vinícius Júnior (33e, 75e) avait pourtant permis aux Auriverdes d'égaliser. Toutefois, le but concédé à Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (91e) dans le temps additionnel a scellé la défaite brésilienne.

Industry observers note that présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção. Le technicien italien a répondu en espagnol à l'ancien international. Une mise au point limpide. « C'est la liberté d'expression et, dans un pays démocratique, tout le monde peut avoir une opinion. Romario a donné la sienne, et tout le monde a le droit de dire des mensonges, des vérités ou des bêtises. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que Romario parle beaucoup, et il est dans son droit », a ainsi rétorqué l'entraîneur face aux journalistes.

According to recent reports, cette sortie directe démontre la volonté du sélectionneur de balayer la polémique alors que la pression médiatique s'accentue. Carlo Ancelotti n'a pas souhaité polémiquer davantage avec l'ancienne gloire du football brésilien, se contentant de souligner avec ironie l'omniprésence médiatique de son détracteur.

According to recent reports, deux jours plus tôt, Romario n'avait pas mâché ses mots à la suite de la défaite concédée face à l'équipe nippone. L'ancien buteur brésilien avait réclamé la destitution immédiate du sélectionneur sur ses réseaux sociaux, estimant qu'Ancelotti ne disposait pas des qualités requises pour diriger le pays. « Ça suffit ! Prends tes affaires et va-t'en ! », avait notamment écrit Romario, très remonté contre l'entraîneur italien.

Au-delà de cette interpellation, Romario a tout de même reconnu les accomplissements passés de Carlo Ancelotti, qualifié d'« un des grands entraîneurs » en club, tout en appelant à son retour sur le Vieux Continent : « Retourne dans les clubs, où tu t'es fait un nom, car la sélection brésilienne ne peut pas continuer à prendre ce risque ». L'ancien international a également interpellé le président de la Confédération brésilienne de football (CBF), Samir Xaud, affirmant qu'il fallait désormais « le courage de prendre une décision ». Cette attaque fait suite à une fin de match sous haute tension contre le Japon, au cours de laquelle Carlo Ancelotti et l'attaquant Raphinha avaient été expulsés pour avoir protesté contre une faute présumée au départ de la troisième réalisation adverse.

Recent findings suggest that lucide quant au niveau affiché par ses joueurs sur le terrain, Carlo Ancelotti n'a éludé aucune question sur les difficultés actuelles de la Seleção. Lors de son point presse, le coach italien a dressé une autocritique sans concession sur le rendement de son groupe. « Je dois faire plus et je vais le faire. J'aime être ici, j'aime être dans la sélection nationale et je dois m'améliorer. Je dois faire plus pour que la sélection redevienne compétitive. Il y a longtemps que nous ne sommes plus compétitifs », a déclaré le technicien italien.

Sources indicate that toutefois, le sélectionneur brésilien a insisté sur la nature amicale de cette rencontre et la nécessité de renouveler son effectif en vue des futures échéances. « C'est évident que c'est le moment des essais. Nous essayons de nouveaux joueurs, en commençant par Gabriel Bontempo, André, Jonathan Jesus... Ce sont des évaluations très positives, sans mentionner de noms. Nous espérons toujours bien jouer, mais il est incompatible d'essayer, de renouveler et d'avoir l'équipe prête. Nous continuons avec une grande confiance dans cette voie et nous nous testerons contre Singapour », a détaillé le sélectionneur brésilien.

Après ce premier revers en Asie, le Brésil doit désormais se remobiliser pour son second match amical de la trêve internationale, prévu le mardi 17 novembre 2026 au Stade national de Singapour face à Singapour. Une rencontre que Carlo Ancelotti devra observer loin de la pelouse : le technicien italien est suspendu de banc de touche suite à son expulsion contre le Japon et ne pourra pas diriger directement ses hommes au bord du terrain. L'équipe devra également composer sans son attaquant Raphinha, lui aussi sous le coup d'une suspension. Pour animer son secteur offensif face aux Singapouriens, Carlo Ancelotti a d'ores et déjà annoncé la titularisation du jeune avant-centre Endrick pour le match du mardi 17 novembre 2026.

  • It has been revealed that L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi.
  • En quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

C'est une annonce majeure pour le football belge en ce lundi 16 novembre 2026. Sur son compte Instagram, Romelu Lukaku a officialisé son départ définitif de la sélection des Diables Rouges après seize années passées au plus haut niveau international.

It has been revealed that L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi. Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, Romelu Lukaku est resté sur le banc des remplaçants sans entrer en jeu, après avoir manqué le match précédent face à la Turquie en raison d'une légère blessure à la hanche. Pour accompagner son message d'adieu sur le réseau social, le joueur a publié une galerie photo retraçant son parcours international depuis ses débuts en mars 2010 à l'âge de 16 ans. Plusieurs coéquipiers emblématiques de la génération dorée, dont Axel Witsel et Thibaut Courtois, ont d'ailleurs salué publiquement sa carrière sous sa publication. Une page se tourne pour les Diables Rouges.

En quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable. L'avant-centre se retire en effet en tant que meilleur buteur absolu de l'histoire de la sélection belge avec 94 buts inscrits en 135 sélections. Au niveau des apparitions, le joueur n'est devancé que par Jan Vertonghen (157 sélections) et Axel Witsel (140 sélections). Pilier de la sélection durant plus d'une décennie, il a disputé quatre phases finales de Coupe du monde (2014, 2018 avec une 3e place, 2022 et 2026) ainsi que trois Championnats d'Europe (2016, 2020 et 2024). Son dernier match officiel sous le maillot des Diables Rouges remonte ainsi au 5 octobre 2026 contre l'équipe de France en Ligue des nations, lors d'une défaite (1-4).

It has been revealed that cette annonce constitue d'ailleurs un revirement par rapport aux intends initialement affichés par l'intéressé. En effet, l'attaquant avait affirmé en janvier 2026 que la Coupe du monde 2026 ne marquerait pas sa dernière compétition majeure avec la Belgique. La sélection des Diables Rouges a elle aussi tenu à rendre hommage à son avant-centre sur son compte officiel X, saluant un joueur qui a écrit un incroyable chapitre de l'histoire de l'équipe nationale.

La situation sportive de l'attaquant s'était toutefois compliquée lors des dernières semaines avec les Diables Rouges. Depuis la prise de fonction de Mark van Bommel comme sélectionneur en août 2026 en remplacement de Rudi Garcia, Romelu Lukaku a vu son temps de jeu diminuer au profit de Charles De Ketelaere. Resté sur le banc lors du récent succès face à l'Italie, le joueur a finalement choisi de renoncer aux prochaines échéances internationales de son pays. En effet, la Belgique disputera les quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations du 25 au 30 mars 2027, dont le tirage au sort est fixé au vendredi 20 novembre 2026 à Nyon.

It has been revealed that toutefois, cette retraite internationale ne met absolument pas un terme à sa carrière en club. Romelu Lukaku évolue sous les couleurs de Fenerbahçe depuis le mois d'août 2026 et reste concentré sur ses objectifs en Turquie. L'attaquant disputera ainsi son prochain match officiel le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 17h00 face à Kocaelispor en Süper Lig.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that présent en conférence de presse ce lundi 16 novembre 2026 à Singapour, Vinicius Jr a livré une mise au point sans détour sur ses récentes difficultés avec le Real Madrid. L'attaquant brésilien a admis avoir diminué son volume d'entraînement estival, profondément affecté par l'élimination précoce de sa sélection lors de la dernière Coupe du monde.

According to recent reports, ce début d'exercice s'avère particulièrement difficile pour le joueur de 26 ans sous les couleurs du club espagnol. Avec un bilan de seulement un but et trois passes décisives en 12 rencontres toutes compétitions confondues avec le Real Madrid, Vinicius Jr traverse une période délicate. Un rendement bien loin de ses standards. La cause de ce passage à vide trouve son origine dans les suites de la Coupe du monde, où le Brésil a quitté la compétition dès les huitièmes de finale après une défaite face à la Norvège (2-1). Très affecté par ce revers, l'attaquant a ainsi privilégié le repos et la déconnexion en famille durant ses vacances, au détriment de sa préparation physique.

Devant les médias à Singapour, l'ailier madrilène a d'ailleurs détaillé avec franchise les raisons de ce déficit athlétique :.

Industry observers note that au-delà de cette déception internationale, le contexte extra-sportif n'a pas aidé le joueur du Real Madrid à aborder cette saison l'esprit totalement libéré. En effet, le dossier de sa prolongation contractuelle et les sollicitations extérieures, notamment l'intérêt de clubs comme Arsenal, ont perturbé sa concentration estivale. L'attaquant a ainsi reconnu que ces remous avaient directement influé sur son niveau de jeu depuis la reprise.

It has been revealed that toutefois, l'ailier madrilène a tenu à rappeler la difficulté de se maintenir au sommet dans la durée. Pour appuyer son constat, il a souligné que seuls Cristiano Ronaldo et Lionel Messi ont su afficher de telles statistiques pendant de longues années. Le numéro 7 brésilien a également rappelé son devoir d'exemplarité, affirmant être conscient que s'il court davantage, tous les jeunes joueurs courront aussi plus.

Vinicius Jr a tempéré les inquiétudes en comparant sa trajectoire à celle de la saison passée, où il ne comptait que 5 buts en décembre avant de dépasser la barre des 20 réalisations au printemps. L'attaquant reste ainsi convaincu que sa montée en puissance physique portera ses fruits au moment opportun.

It has been revealed that sur le plan sportif en sélection, Vinicius Jr s'est d'ailleurs redonné de la confiance en signant un doublé samedi 14 novembre 2026 lors de la défaite du Brésil contre le Japon (2-3) au Stade national de Singapour. Le Brésil dispute désormais son prochain match amical face à Singapour le mardi 17 novembre 2026 à 11h00 (heure française) au Stade national de Singapour. Le prochain rendez-vous de Vinicius Jr avec le Real Madrid est ensuite programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 21h00 face au Celta Vigo au stade Santiago-Bernabéu pour la 13e journée de Liga.

Il workshop intende ribadire quanto già illustrato nel primo tavolo, tenutosi lo scorso 6 ottobre: il diabete non rappresenta alcun limite nel poter fare sport,.

Si terrà oggi alle 18 il secondo seminario del ciclo ‘Diabete in Libertà – Sport e Diabete’, fortemente voluto dalla Fondazione Lazio ETS, avente come focus il rapporto tra sport e diabete. L’incontro, realizzato in collaborazione con ANIAD, l’Associazione Nazionale Italiana Atleti Diabetici e AMD, Associazione Medici Diabetologi, si svolgerà con due modalità: in presenza nella Torretta di Piazza della Libertà e anche on line tramite zoom.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Industry observers note that il numero 1 al mondo del tennis, ha avuto la sua prima diagnosi di diabete nel 2001, a soli 4 anni. Il campione tedesco ha reso nota la sua condizione nel 2022.A illustrare ai partecipanti tutte le possibilità che la scienza e la medicina mettono a disposizione dei soggetti affetti da diabete, sarà il professor Felice Strollo, specialista in Endocrinologia e docente di Medicina Aeronautica e Spaziale. Strollo attualmente ricopre anche il ruolo di Membro del Comitato Scientifico dell'ANIADIl seminario odierno è rivolto a tutti i pazienti, agli addetti ai lavori e non solo a sportivi professionisti. L’obiettivo è chiaro: far comprendere che con il diabete si può convivere serenamente, fare sport e condurre una vita senza alcun tipo di condizionamento.

Il seminario avrà luogo oggi alle 18 presso la Torretta di Piazza della Libertà. Per favorire la massima partecipazione, sarà possibile accedere anche tramite Zoom. L’ID riunione è 896 06 29 3452, il codice d’accesso è 929913.

£329m spent and still no goals for sorry Tottenham

📅 12 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 21 min read (4104 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~21 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Tottenham Hotspur have never before in the club’s history begun a league season without scoring a single goal in the first four games, although having done so after spending £329m on newly introduced players really does take some doing.
  • “Please score a goal!” was the homemade sign from two Spurs fans upon which the television cameras lingered at the end of the game, although the jaunty felt-tip design and glued-on team crest were rather upbeat compared to the gloom of the stadium.
  • According to recent reports, A team reimagined, a manager freshly debuted and yet they are back in the same grip of anxiety that accompanied them on two consecutive 17th-place finishes in the last two seasons.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Tottenham Hotspur have never before in the club’s history begun a league season without scoring a single goal in the first four games, although having done so after spending £329m on newly introduced players really does take some doing.

“Please score a goal!” was the homemade sign from two Spurs fans upon which the television cameras lingered at the end of the game, although the jaunty felt-tip design and glued-on team crest were rather upbeat compared to the gloom of the stadium. Spurs have tried to outrun their past but it just keeps catching up with them.

According to recent reports, A team reimagined, a manager freshly debuted and yet they are back in the same grip of anxiety that accompanied them on two consecutive 17th-place finishes in the last two seasons. By the end of this they might have been glad to escape with a single point against Everton, the one team in the Premier League who closed the window with a net transfer profit.

Sources indicate that for Roberto De Zerbi, there was another passionate defence of his team afterwards. “The people, the fans already understand if I make excuses or not,” he noted. “I came last season when the s--- was like this”, he gestured to a level somewhere around the midpoint of his forehead. “I have always been… not positive but realistic. I am sorry for the result that it’s not immediately the improvement. We played as a team. We didn’t score. We didn’t win [but] we played as a team.”.

In a recent development, indeed he co-opted the Italian term “sbloccare” to describe his team’s problem. They simply need to unlock – or unblock – the team and the goals would flow. He joked that in Italy he would be lauded for two consecutive clean sheets in this game and the previous one against Nottingham Forest. “What did you write?” he demanded of one of the Italian newspaper correspondents. “You have the passport.”.

Spurs have one last game at home this month, on Saturday against Aston Villa, to end the streak in September. They were into the second half before the first attempt on target that obliged Jordan Pickford to make a save – Mateus Fernandes’s shot slapping limply against the Everton goalkeeper’s gloves to ironic cheers from the home fans.

At the end De Zerbi could not contain his frustration, unable to wait until he reached the privacy of the dressing room to tell Mathys Tel where he had gone wrong. He did so with the Spurs substitute still wiping the sweat from his brow on the pitch. The player did not look at all impressed. De Zerbi noted later that he was simply reminding his player of what it took to play as a central striker.

“There is a term in Italian, ‘sbloccare’ that literally translates as ‘unblock’… I know we can score goals and win games. We have to respect the history of the players – if you forget [Dominic] Solanke and [Omar] Marmoush the others haven’t scored many in their careers. I think we can find the goals with the quality of the players.”.

Spurs play Liverpool at Anfield in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday before Villa a week today. The Spurs record at home is dismal. In the last 35 games they have won just five, drawn 10 and lost a remarkable 20. This new stadium has become a problem for the team in it – or maybe it is the other way around.

It has been revealed that A good result for Everton, who were under pressure for most of the first half but had much the better of it after the break. David Moyes’s team finished the game with more shots on target than the home team. Moyes managed the game well and trusted his team to withstand the Spurs possession in the first half until they reached a point where Everton could start to push back.

Hard to pick out any major chances – it was that kind of game – but Brennan Johnson should have won it for the away team in the second half. The ball was cut back to him by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall and the former Spurs man skied his shot.

In a recent development, some surprised faces then when Moyes said later that he had expected a lot more from his team. He acknowledged the resilience in defence and the importance of the clean sheet. “We played well enough,” he said, “but when we had the ball we turned it over more often than we should have done.”.

Recent findings suggest that the game had started with Vitaliy Mykolenko being tortured by the pace of Sávio and ended with the Ukrainian left-back being given the man of the match award. Like many of his team-mates, he had hung in there. There was another fine performance from Jarrad Branthwaite at centre-half and Moyes stated that he hoped it might earn him a place in the England squad. “He is still finding his way back from injury,” Moyes said, “it would be great if he could get a call-up.”.

In the directors’ box were the usual pained expressions of Vinai Venkatesham, the Spurs chief executive, and chairman Peter Charrington. They sat alongside Vivienne Lewis, daughter of the patriarch Joe. There is a certain fatigue about the home crowd when faced with afternoons like this which suggests they have seen so much that the bar is quite high – or low – to provoke a really splenetic response. Perhaps it is just too early in the season although the final whistle was met with boos.

Industry observers note that the first shot on target of the entire game for either side was a free-kick struck by James Garner in added time at the end of the first half. Spurs had started at a ferocious pace although they could not sustain it.

De Zerbi complained about the pre-season injuries on tour in Australia and also the lack of time he had to integrate Sávio and Marmoush. He said that his team were not in the right “physical condition”.

It has been revealed that “We played very well in the first 30 minutes and maybe the energy and the fact we didn’t score – we lost confidence.” By the end, he had sent on James Maddison, Tel, Lucas Bergvall and Mohammed Kudus to little avail. Everton looked more likely to win it.

Recent findings suggest that speaking to Sky Sports, the Everton defender noted: “You look at the game from the start, they put us under pressure and we had to dig deep to stay in the game. Then we grew into the game towards the end of the first half and indicated that mentality again in the second half.

According to recent reports, “We had chances to win the game as well. The backs to the wall mentality will help us go a long way. If we can keep clean sheets, you can go a long way in the league. But it’s not just us the defenders. It’s the whole team working hard. It’s a team effort.”.

"I feel like we could've taken three points" James Tarkowski speaks after his sides draw with Spurs 🎙️ pic.twitter.com/Wdj3N5hk8l.

"Six hours and we've not scored a goal? It's a DISGRACE" 😬Ashley Young claims that the Spurs players will need to have conversations about their lack of threat going forward ❌ pic.twitter.com/0KNomGEavx.

"Absolutely diabolical" 😬Jamie Redknapp on Spurs not scoring in their first four Premier League games 😳 pic.twitter.com/48Nbxymlev.

Industry observers note that tottenham failed to take the attacking initiative or create any notable chances. De Zerbi used multiple forward players in a host of attacking positions, but no one could find the breakthrough.

Boos ring around the ground as Spurs and Everton both have to settle for a point. Tottenham’s winless start to the season continues, while Everton’s unbeaten run remains intact. Spurs haven’t managed a goal in six hours of Premier League football across the 2026-27 campaign. Tottenham sit 17th with two points. Everton are up to seventh and will certainly take the draw.

FULL-TIME: The points are shared between Spurs and Everton at Tottenham Hotspur stadium 🤝 pic.twitter.com/HwPuKI3Ajh.

Industry observers note that dewsbury-Hall’s deflected effort flies out for a corner. Everton can’t make the most of the resulting set piece and Tottenham survive.

It has been revealed that there will be three minutes of added time. Are we set for late drama at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium?

Pickford makes an error as his poor clearance is intercepted by Maddison. The ball is eventually worked to Bergvall, whose curling effort is parried away by the Everton goalkeeper.

Jordan Pickford gets down well to deny Lucas Bergvall! 🧤 pic.twitter.com/59uoHTqto6.

According to recent reports, tosin comes on for his Spurs debut as he replaces Gray. Can anyone be Tottenham’s hero and find a late winner?

Industry observers note that garner is booked after he clatters into Savio. Everton have produced a tough and disciplined defensive perfomance so far.

Industry observers note that spurs are now enjoying a sustained period of possession. They’re waiting to fashion a substantial chance and end their wait for a top-flight goal in the 2026-27 season.

De Zerbi makes another change as Maddison enters the action with applause from the Spurs faithful. He replaces Marmoush. It looks like Tel is now operating as a false nine.

Johnson misses a huge chance! Dewsbury-Hall fires a low cross into his path and Johnson takes the chance with a first-time shot, but he slices his effort and it goes over the bar. He’s got to do better from that range inside the penalty area.

That opportunity is Johnson’s last action of the match as he comes off for Hackney. O’Brien is also introduced, replacing Maitland-Niles.

That was the chance. Dewsbury-Hall rolls it into the path of Spurs’ Europa League final winner Brennan Johnson and he skied it. He hasn’t scored since he left Spurs in January for Palace.

"What a chance this was!"Brennan Johnson had the chance to put Everton in front against his former club 😯 pic.twitter.com/fUi7t6hX7t.

Everton look like the far likelier side to break the deadlock. De Zerbi’s changes have done little to affect the game. Marmoush is cutting a very frustrated figure up top for Spurs.

Bergvall finds Savio with a whipped cross. The winger tries to help the ball back into the danger zone, but Pickford reacts quickly and collects possession.

Dewsbury-Hall picks up the game’s first yellow card after catching Tonali with a late sliding challenge.

What is Kinsky doing?! The goalkeeper’s dreadful pass which was intended for Tonali is intercepted by Dewsbury-Hall, who tries to slide a low effort through Kinsky’s legs. The Tottenham man redeems himself with a crucial save to keep the scoreline goalless. The hosts are living so dangerously. Kinsky needs to wake up.

Antonín Kinský redeems himself after Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall fails to take advantage! 😮 pic.twitter.com/nuKZju90Wz.

Moyes responds with a straight swap on the wing as Grealish comes on for George.

Enter: Grealish. He is on for Tyrique George. Surprised that Brennan Johnson survived that change. He has struggled to make an impression.

In a recent development, following Spurs’ reshuffle, it looks like Savio will stay out wide on the right, with Tel on the left. Kudus will sit as the central playmaker behind Marmoush, who is now the lone frontman.

De Zerbi orders a much-needed triple change as Kudus, Tel and Bergvall replace Solanke, Fernandes and Bentancur.

Jack Grealish has long since stopped the warm-up on the touchline and is now just staring at the game in expectation of his introduction.

Sources indicate that A couple of chances for Everton. Spurs have survived but they look so vulnerable when Everton turn over possession. Crowd could turn soon. Almost reached the hour-mark on matchday 4 and still no Spurs’ Premier League goal.

According to recent reports, the start of Spurs’ second-half performance is alarmingly similar to their display against Newcastle two weeks ago. That day, Tottenham allowed Newcastle to seize the initiative and they netted two second-half goals without reply. Everton are gaining confidence as Spurs continue to lack courage or threat. The crowd is getting more and more restless.

Tottenham fail to clear a corner and the ball lands at George’s feet. The Everton winger shoots but his fierce drive is blocked by Bentancur. The whole of Spurs’ bench is warming up. The visitors at the moment have the momentum and the hosts look nervous.

Everton are looking threatening once again as George attempts to thread a pass through to Johnson on the counter-attack, but Van de Ven is there to clear.

Recent findings suggest that george does brilliantly to escape away from Gray and floats a cross towards the back post. Barry rises highest and his close-range header is blocked by Kinsky. The Tottenham goalkeeper didn’t know much about it, but that’s a massive stop. Undoubtedly the game’s most dangerous moment in front of goal so far.

Spurs’ first shot has arrived! Unfortunately, Fernandes’ tame long-range effort is easily gathered by Pickford. There were some sarcastic cheers from the Tottenham fans as Fernandes took aim. They clearly want more attacking inspiration from their players.

Ironic cheers as Spurs have their first shot on target. It has taken them until the start of the second half and it would be hard to say Fernandes stung the palms of Pickford.

We are back under way for the second half. Everton and Spurs are both unchanged at the break. With the anxiety building in the stadium as the game remains goalless, how long will De Zerbi wait before making a change?

An uneventful first half of football comes to a close. In a game lacking rhythm, creativity and attacking spark, nothing separates Tottenham and Everton at the break. Spurs’ search for a first Premier League goal this season continues.

There will be two added minutes. Everton have a free kick on the edge of Spurs’ penalty area. Garner and Dewsbury-Hall are standing over it. The former Manchester United and Nottingham Forest midfielder takes it and his effort bounces in front of Kinsky, who pushes it out for a corner.

James Garner free-kick pushed away by Kinsky is the game’s first attempt on target.

In a recent development, there has not been a single attempt on target at 40:27 from either team. Spurs have had the best of it but even so. That’s a poor return.

Another attack fizzles out for Spurs. Substitute Jack Grealish engaging in some badinage with home fans as he warms up. He famously agreed a move to Spurs in 2018, called off at the eleventh hour when Aston Villa were sold to the current ownership.

That is so poor from Fernandes. The summer signing’s overhit corner drifts out for a goal kick. Suddenly, Spurs’ attacking play has fallen quite flat.

It has been revealed that pickford does well to intercept Robertson’s inviting low cross. The left back needed Solanke or Marmoush to make a darting near-post run there to give him more options.

Spurs are bossing this game but on the rare occasions Everton escape you do wonder if they might score.

Tottenham are roared on by the home support to move the ball a bit quicker going forward. Out of possession, Everton almost revert to a back five, with Garner dropping very deep near to Tarkowski and Branthwaite.

Tonali picks out Gray with a pinpoint pass. Garner is alert to the danger and tracks back to clear, stopping Gray from getting a one-on-one opportunity.

Recent findings suggest that maitland-Niles does very well to dispossess Tonali in a dangerous area, allowing Barry to tee up Dewsbury-Hall, but his shot is smothered by the Spurs defence. Mykolenko then chips a cross into a box, but it’s tapped behind for a corner by Robertson. Moyes will certainly be encouraged by this side’s resurgence over the last 10 minutes.

There is a break in play here with Gray down and receiving treatment after a collision. He appears to be holding his lower back. The Tottenham man gingerly gets back to his feet and trudges off the pitch.

Gray down for some extended treatment. Richarlison in the stands. Spurs in danger of losing early momentum.

After Spurs’ fast start, Everton have grown into the contest over the last five minutes and are getting on the ball far higher up the pitch.

Garner’s corner is cleared by Spurs, but only as far as Maitland-Niles. In similar range to where he scored that stunning equaliser against Manchester United, the former Arsenal man shoots, but his attempt fizzes well wide.

It has been revealed that spurs are really flowing here. Finding the balls through the lines and real speed when they attack Everton. Massive question is whether they can convert that into goals. Van Hecke and Fernandes both had chances.

Sávio has had a fine start to the game. Mykolenko in for a long afternoon. Spurs have looked dangerous and should be 1-0 up.

Tonali finds Savio with a deep cross, leaving Pickford in no-man’s land. The Brazilian keeps the ball in play and it loops up, just out of Marmoush’s reach.

Robertson floats a teasing delivery into Van Hecke at the back post, but the centre-back directs his half-volley over the bar from close range.

Sources indicate that spurs then burst forward again through Savio, who feeds Fernandes. The playmaker’s low drive is heroically blocked by Tarkowski as Everton continue to hold on (just about).

Sources indicate that as expected, it’s Tottenham with all the early possession, with Everton sitting very deep and soaking up the early pressure. Marmoush turns Armstrong and wins a free-kick in a dangerous area.

They’re under way in north London, the hosts are in their lily-white and navy kit, with Everton in their grey/dirty green (is that a colour?!) away number.

Greetings from N17. It’s a wonderful, warm late summer evening. As expected there is the usual foreboding from the home fans. Two defeats and one draw. The mood will sour further if Spurs do not win today. No Porro or Udogie so Archie Gray, ever adaptable, starts at right-back again.

In a recent development, everton are undefeated with five points from three games. They have a decent 16/17 players but it is the reserves beyond that which everyone is concerned about. Grealish and Dibling on the bench give them two potential game-changers. Spurs’ squad looks very strong on the team-sheet. A full bench of experienced pros and no fillers. On the pitch it has been less convincing.

Brennan Johnson spent two years at Tottenham and scored the winning goal in the 1-0 Europa League final victory over Manchester United in May 2025, ending the club’s 17-year trophy drought.

After a short, disappointing spell at Crystal Palace, Johnson joined Everton last month, with Dwight McNeil moving in the opposite direction.

The Welsh winger starts for Everton today. Could he hurt his previous employers on a day where they desperately need a win?

Recent findings suggest that brennan in the building. 💙 pic.twitter.com/94GgAY8c56.

Midfielder took exception to negativity surrounding club after moves for players on deadline day failed to materialise.

Industry observers note that “We signed Jack [Grealish], which was nice, and I’d been speaking to him,” says Dewsbury-Hall, sitting in a café at the club’s Finch Farm training base. “But I had seen all the stuff [online], all the meltdowns about this and that and, in all honestly, it annoyed me a bit.

“I get where people are coming from. Everyone wants to sign everyone and have the perfect squad, but there are still 19 lads in this building who are going to hopefully take this club to good things this year. That was getting disregarded. I was seeing people saying: ‘We’ll be lucky to stay up this year.’.

Recent findings suggest that “What message is that sending to the lads who are already here? I’m not blaming anyone. We get it. It didn’t work. But let’s all be positive – right, it’s done, bang, let’s go. That’s what we’ve been trying to say in the dressing room.”.

Earlier this week, Mykhailo Mudryk picked up an ankle injury in training which has ruled the Chelsea loanee out of action for as long as two months.

The winger only made his debut for Tottenham as a late substitute against Nottingham Forest last week, but his attempt to rebuild his career following his anti-doping ban has been dealt a major blow.

Folarin Balogun’s proposed £39m move from Monaco collapsed on transfer deadline day, Richarlison’s return to the club didn’t materialise and Beto was sold to Fiorentina, leaving Thierno Barry as Everton’s only recognised striker.

Nottingham Forest’s pursuit of academy product Harrison Armstrong ruffled the fans’ feathers, while Iliman Ndiaye was sold to Manchester City for £60m.

Dwight McNeil, Tim Iroegbunam, Nathan Patterson, Adam Aznou and Idrissa Gueye were also allowed to leave.

Merlin Rohl and Tyrique George made their loans permanent, while Brennan Johnson, Hayden Hackney and Christian Norgaard were also added to the squad.

Summer signing Ainsley Maitland-Niles and Vitaliy Mykolenko are David Moyes’ only options at full-back.

Overall, there were a number of solid additions, just not enough of them to cover all the departures.

Industry observers note that 🎧🫡 Thierno Barry ahead of today's clash in North London. pic.twitter.com/mwlsKH8Pid.

Tottenham: Kinsky; Gray, Van de Ven, Van Hecke, Robertson; Tonali, Bentancur, Fernandes; Savio, Solankem, Marmoush.

Subs: Dubravka, Tosin, Senesi, Gallagher, Maddison, Tel, Bergvall, Kudus, Davies.

Everton: Pickford; Maitland-Niles, Tarkowski, Brathwaite, Mykolenko; Armstrong, Garner; Johnson, Dewsbury-Hall, George; Barry.

Subs: Travers, O’Brien, Keane, King, Alcaraz, Graham, Hackney, Dibling, Grealish.

In a recent development, after scoring that last-minute leveller against Manchester United last time out, Ainsley Maitland-Niles is promoted to the starting 11 and replaces Merlin Rohl. Brennan Johnson returns to his former club and starts, while Jack Grealish is on the bench.

Roberto De Zerbi has made four alterations from last weekend’s stalemate with Nottingham Forest. Dominic Solanke, Mateus Fernandes, Archie Gray and Andy Robertson all come into the line-up. Pedro Porro and Destiny Udogie are out injured, while Conor Gallagher and Mathys Tel are relegated to the bench. Tosin Adarabioyo and James Maddison are also among the substitutes.

Hello and welcome to our live coverage of this Premier League meeting between Tottenham and Everton in the capital.

IT'S A GAME CHANGER! Scotland to co-host Women's World Cup with England, Northern Ireland and Wales in 2035

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (859 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 13:05 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 17:59 EST, 23 November 2026.
  • Scotland, England, Northern Ireland and Wales have been confirmed as the joint hosts of the 2035 Women’s World Cup.
  • The four-nation bid was given the official seal of approval in a vote by acclamation at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress on Monday, having been the sole valid bid in contention for the event.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 13:05 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 17:59 EST, 23 November 2026.

Scotland, England, Northern Ireland and Wales have been confirmed as the joint hosts of the 2035 Women’s World Cup.

The four-nation bid was given the official seal of approval in a vote by acclamation at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress on Monday, having been the sole valid bid in contention for the event.

It will be the first men’s or women’s World Cup finals to be staged in the UK since the 1966 men’s tournament was held in England.

Nineteen stadiums are proposed, with 14 in England, one in Northern Ireland, two in Scotland (Hampden and Easter Road) and two in Wales in a tournament which will feature 48 teams.

A further three stadiums could be added – Birmingham’s latest Powerhouse Stadium, Wrexham’s redeveloped Racecourse Ground and a potential new Chelsea stadium – which would take the tournament to 16 cities and 22 stadiums across the four nations.

The bid team projected the tournament would attract 3.5 billion viewers worldwide, and that 4.5 million tickets would be sold.

Joy for Spain after they defeated England in the 2023 Women's World Cup final.

Scotland captain Caroline Weir says the World Cup will take the nation's game to another level.

FIFA’s evaluation of the bid, published earlier this month, rated it 4.3 out of five.

For England this represents another chance to host a major women’s tournament, having hosted the European Championship in 2022 which the Lionesses won.

The Congress also approved the joint bid by Mexico, the United States, Costa Rica and Jamaica to host the 2031 finals, which will be the first to feature 48 teams.

Industry observers note that prime Minister Andy Burnham stated: 'The world is coming to the United Kingdom. In 2035 the biggest tournament in women’s sport will be played in cities across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, bringing visitors, investment and jobs to every part of the country.

According to recent reports, 'Our players have inspired a generation of girls. In 2035 that generation will watch the best in the world play on their doorstep – and some of them will be on the pitch. But the impact of this World Cup will go much further. It will reach into communities across the country, bring more people into the game and leave a legacy that lasts long after the final whistle.'.

FIFA president Gianni Infantino reveals the home nations as World Cup hosts.

Scotland captain Caroline Weir added: 'The women’s game in Scotland has so much potential and this tournament is a real opportunity to drive momentum and help take it to another level both nationally and internationally.

'We’re so proud to play our part in welcoming the world in 2035 and I know I speak on behalf of all of the players and staff when I say that we are ready to rise to the challenge and help deliver a truly memorable, world-class tournament.'.

England forward Michelle Agyemang stated it was 'incredibly special' and added: 'I’ve been lucky enough to know what it feels like to play for my country in a major tournament, and those are moments you dream about as a young girl playing football.

'The thought of another generation growing up knowing that the biggest stage in the game is coming to their home country is amazing. To have the chance to play in a home World Cup would be a dream, but even more exciting is thinking about all the girls watching who might see 2035 and believe they can be part of it one day.'.

SFA chief Ian Maxwell says tournament will be 'most significant thing to happen to women's and girls' game in Scotland'.

Scottish Football Association chief executive Ian Maxwell remarked hosting the tournament would be 'the most significant thing to happen to the women's and girls' game in Scotland'.

He said: 'The impact would go far beyond just the matches themselves. The level of investment into coaching, facilities and player pathways in the years beforehand will shape the future of the game for the generations to come.'.

First Minister John Swinney noted: 'This is fantastic news for Scotland. We have proved time and again that we are a world-class host, and I am delighted that the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2035 will be held in Scotland alongside England, Wales and Northern Ireland.

Recent findings suggest that 'The timing is ideal. Project 2035, our fresh long-term blueprint to grow the girls’ and women’s game, aims to establish Scotland as a leading nation for women’s football by 2035. Our newly established girls’ and women’s football taskforce will help to make this happen, capitalising on the World Cup and leaving a lasting legacy for communities across the country.

'Scotland is building a remarkable reputation for hosting major events, and the FIFA Women’s World Cup joins the Tour de France Grand Départ, The Open, the World Rally Championships and UEFA EURO 2028 in promising to showcase what our country has to offer. We will make sure each one of these amazing sporting events delivers for our economy, supporting jobs, businesses and tourism.'.
